sa: इत्येवं परुषं वाक्यं ब्रुवाणे हरिपुंगवे। अमर्षवशमापन्नो निशाचरगणेश्वरः।॥
en: When that monkey-chief had spoken thus, the lord of the night-rangers was wrought up with wrath.

sa: मोहजालस्य योनिर्हि मूढेरेव समागमः। अहन्यहनिधर्मस्य योनिः साधुसमागमः॥
en: Association with the fools produces delusion, as daily association with the honest and good produces virtue.

sa: अन्ये च बहवः शूरा महात्मानो निपातिताः। प्रख्यातबलवीर्येण पुत्रेणेन्द्रजिता मम॥ तौ भ्रातरौ तदा बद्धौ घोरैर्दत्तवरैः शरैः। यन्न शक्यं सुरैः सर्वैरसुरैर्वा महाबलैः॥ मोक्तुं तद्वन्धनं घोरं यक्षगन्धर्वपत्रगैः। तन्न जाने प्रभावैर्वा मायया मोहनेन वा॥ शरबन्धाद्विमुक्तौ तौ भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ।
en: Other Rākşasas having gigantic bodies and skilled in various arms, countless high-souled heroes—have also been brought down. These brothers were formerly bound by my son Indrajit of renowned strength and prowess with terrific shafts, obtained as boons. And I do not know by what power or superhuman virtue stupefying energy did those brothers, Rāma and Lakşmaņa-liberate themselves from those dreadful bonds, which could be loosed neither by celestials nor the highly powerful Asuras combined Yaksas, Gandharvas and Pannagas.

sa: सोऽपश्यद् भूमिभागांश्च नगप्रस्रवणानि च। सुवर्णवृक्षानपरान् ददर्श शिखिसंनिभान्॥
en: And he saw the glebe, the hill streams and many a golden trees resembling the fire.

sa: स तस्य ददृशे मार्गो मांसशोणितकर्दमः। पतितैः पर्वताकारैर्वानरैरभिसंवृतः॥
en: His course was discovered, miry with flesh and blood and blocked up with mountain-like monkeys fallen.

sa: यदि चेन्द्राद्भयं राजन्यदि चापि स्वयंभुवः। अपि देवाः शयिष्यन्ते मयि कुद्धे महीतले। ५१।। यमं च शमयिष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि पावकम्।
en: O king, if your fear springs from Indra or the Self-create, even the immortals shall measure their lengths on the earth when I am wrought with rage. And I shall subdue Yama himself and devour the God of Fire.

sa: राक्षसीनां वचः श्रुत्वा सीता पद्मनिभेक्षणा। नेत्राभ्यामश्रुपूर्णाभ्यामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the words of those Rākşasīs, the lotus-eyed Sītā, with her eyes full of tears said.

sa: गजो गवाक्षो गवयः शरभो गन्धमादनः। समन्तात्परिधावन्तो ररक्षुहरिवाहिनीम्॥
en: And Gaya, and Gavāksa, and Gavaya, and Śarabha, and Gandhamādana, protected the monkey-army, coursing all around.

sa: तदृष्ट्वा सुमहत्कर्म कृतं वानरसत्तमैः। क्रोधमाहारयामास युधि तीव्रमकम्पनः॥
en: And witnessing that mighty exploit of the foremost of the monkeys, Akampana waxed furious with wrath.

sa: स तु तारं विनिर्भय॑ रावणो लोकरावणः। पुष्पकं तत्समारुह्य प्रययौ दक्षिणार्णवम्॥ तब हेमगिरिप्रख्यं तरुणार्कनिभाननम्। रावणो बालिनं दृष्ट्वा संध्योपासनतत्परम्॥
en: Hearing those words, Rāvana, the aggrandiser of the triple world, remonstrated with Tāra and ascending his flowery car went to the southern ocean and espied Vali, having red countenance like the rising sun, engaged in Sandhyā rites with whole-mindedness.

sa: अभीक्ष्णं निःश्वसन्तौ वै युध्येतां तुमुलौ युधि। शरसंकृत्तसर्वाङ्गौ सर्वतो रुधिरोक्षितौ।। सुदीर्घकालं तौ वीरावन्योन्यं निशितैः शरैः॥
en: And sighing again and again, they faught furiously. And with their persons cut all over, and laved in blood, for a long while the heroes kept cleaving each other with sharpened shafts.

sa: तस्मिंस्तमसि दुष्पारे राक्षसाः क्रोधमूच्छिताः। परिपेतुर्महावेगा भक्षयन्ता प्लवंगमान्॥
en: And in that limitless gloom, the Rākṣasas, transported with wrath, advanced with impetuous speed, devouring monkeys.

sa: ततः कतिपयाहःसु वैदेहं मिथिलाधिपम्। राघवः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥ भवान्हि गतिरव्यग्रा भवता पालिता वयम्। भवतस्तेजसोग्रेण रावणो निहतो मया॥
en: Some days having clasped, he, with folded hands, said to Janaka, the king of Mithila, "You are our only refuge-we have reared by you and by the help of your dreadful prowess we have been able to destroy Rāvaņa.

sa: ततः शरसहस्रेण राममक्लिष्टकारिणम्। अर्दयित्वा शरौघेण मातलिं प्रत्यविध्यत॥
en: Smiting Rama of untiring deeds with thousands of shafts, (Ravana) pierced Matali with vollies of arrows.

sa: आरोपितो विमानं तद्भरतः सत्यविक्रमः। राममासाद्य मुदितः पुनरेवाभ्यवादयत्॥
en: Ascending that car, Bharata, having truth for his prowess, reaching Rāma, delighted, again bowed to him.

sa: नर्मदापुलिने यत्र राक्षसेन्द्रः स दारुणः। पुष्पोपहारं कुरुते तस्माद्देशाददूरतः॥ अर्जुनो जयतां श्रेष्ठो माहिष्मत्याः पतिः प्रभुः। क्रीडते सह नारीभिर्नर्मदातोयमाश्रितः॥
en: At no distance from where on the banks of the river Narmadā, that dreadful lord of Rākşasas collected the flowers, Arjuna, the King of Māhismatī, and the foremost of the victorious, was sporting with his wives in the water.

sa: ततः परमसंक्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः। अब्रवीद्रक्षसां मध्ये संस्तम्भयिषुराहवे॥
en: Then exceedingly enraged, Ravana-lord of Rākşasas-spoke in the midst of the Räkşasas, inciting them to battle.

sa: ततोऽगस्त्यो महातेजा राघवं चेदमब्रवीत्। दृष्टाः सभाजिताश्चापि राम यास्यामहे वयम्॥ एवमुक्त्वा गताः सर्वे पूजितास्ते यथागतम्॥
en: Thereupon the highly effulgent Agastya said to Rama: "O Rāma, we have all seen you and been honoured; now we shall depart.” Saying this, they, being honoured, repaired to their respective habitations.

sa: समीननक्रमकरः सपुष्पकुशसंस्तरः। स नर्मदाम्भसो वेगः प्रावृट्काल इवाबभौ॥
en: The currents of Narmadā, rising high as during the rainy season flowed with fishes, and crocodiles.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु हनुमान्सीतया वाक्यकोविदः। प्रत्युवाच ततः सीतां रामपत्नीमनिन्दिताम्॥
en: Being thus addressed by Sītā, Hanumān, skilled in speech, spoke to the blameless Rama's spouse, saying.

sa: कोसलानां च नक्षत्रं व्यक्तमिन्द्राग्निदैवतम्॥ आहत्याङ्गारकस्तस्थौ विशाखमपि चाम्बरे।
en: That star of the Kośalas, relating to the deities-Indra and Agni-Angaraka-stood in the sky, attacking Visakha.

sa: विनष्टा जानकी व्यक्तं न ह्यदग्धः प्रदृश्यते। लङ्कायाः कश्चिदुद्देशः सर्वा भस्मीकृता पुरी॥ दहता च मया लङ्कां दग्धा सीता न संशयः। रामस्य च महत्कार्यं मयेदं विफलीकृतम्॥
en: I was not the least flurried at it. Forsooth has Jānaki been destroyed for behold I nothing in Lankā which has not been burnt down— indeed the whole city has been reduced to ashes. For certain have I burnt down Sītă while burning the city Lankā-and I have thus baffled the great work of Rāma.

sa: आकर्षन्तः शरीराणि शरीरावयवांस्तथा। नराश्वगजसंघानां शिरांसि च ततस्ततः॥
en: And dragging out the bodies and limbs and heads, O king, of slain men, steeds, elephants.

sa: भीमसेनश्च समरे मृदनंस्तव महारथान्॥ अभ्यधावदभिप्रेप्स राजानं शत्रुभिर्वृतम्।
en: Grinding the great car-warriors your army Bhimasena too went where Yudhishthira was surrounded by his enemies.

sa: हन्तास्मि वृषसेनं ते प्रेक्षमाणस्य संयुगे। ये चान्येऽप्युपयास्यन्ति बुद्धिमोहेन मां नृपाः॥ तांश्च सर्वान् हनिष्यामि सत्येनायुधमालभे। त्वां च मूढाकृतप्रज्ञमतिमानिनमाहवे॥ दृष्ट्वा दुर्योधनो मन्दो भृशं तप्स्यति पातितम्। अर्जुनेन प्रतिज्ञाते वधे कर्णसुतस्य तु॥
en: I swear truly by my bow that I will slay, in your very sight, Vrishasena and will destroy all those other kings, who through cloudiness of intellect will oppose me in battle. Fool, unwise and self-conceited that you are, the wicked Duryodhana will give way to lamentations seeing you slain on the field of battle. Arjuna having promised to kill the son of Karna.

sa: कवची स शरी खड्गी धन्वी च वरभूषणः। विश्रब्धं गच्छ शैनेय मा कार्षीर्मयि सम्भ्रमम्। धृष्टद्युम्नो रणे क्रुद्धं द्रोणमावारयिष्यति॥
en: Cased in mail, armed with shafts, swords, bow and decked with many ornaments. Therefore, O grandson of Sini, go with an easy heart and entertain no anxiety on my account. Dhrishtadyumna himself will resist the enraged Drona in battle.

sa: न हि जानामि वृत्तान्तं धर्मराजस्य केशव। सात्वतेन विहीनः स यदि जीवति वा न वा॥
en: O Keshava, I do not know the where abouts of the very virtuous king Yudhishthira. I am doubtful whether he lives or not, being deprived of the help of this Satvata hero.

sa: रुक्मपुङ्खान् प्रसन्नाग्राञ्छरान् संनतपर्वणः। अवासृजदमेयात्मा दिक्षु सर्वासु पाण्डवः॥
en: The immeasurably energetic son of Pandu sent out his straight and sharp-pointed shafts towards all directions.

sa: अहं वः पाण्डुपुत्रेभ्यस्त्रास्यामीति तदब्रवीत्। धृतराष्ट्रसुतान् कर्णः श्लाघमानोऽऽत्मनो गुणान्॥२७ अनृतं तत् करिष्यन्ति मामका निशिताः शराः। उद्योगः पाण्डुपुत्राणां समाप्तिमुपयास्यति॥
en: While addressing the sons of Dhritarashtra Karna let fall from his lips these words, full of sound and fury-"I will save you of the sons of Pandu," today my keen shafts will belie even those imperious words of his.

sa: प्रकाशितायां तु ततो ध्वजिन्यां द्रोणोऽग्निकल्पः प्रतपन् समन्तात्। रराज राजेन्द्र सुवर्णवर्मा मध्यं गतः सूर्य इवांशुमाली॥
en: When the army was thus lighted up, Drona, like the fire, scorching everything around, looked resplendent, O king of kings, with his golden armour on, like the mid-day sun of blazing rays.

sa: द्रोण उवाच चिन्त्यं बहुविधं तात यत् कृत्यं तच्छृणुष्व मे। त्रयो हि समतिक्रान्ताः पाण्डवानां महारथाः॥
en: Drona said O mighty monarch, there are many things to be thought of, but hear what should be done now. Three mighty car-warriors of the Pandava host have penetrated into our army.

sa: शारद्वतस्तु विंशत्या वासुदेवं समार्पयत्। धनंजयं द्वादशभिराजघान शिलीमुखैः॥
en: The son of Saradvata pierced Vasudeva with twenty arrows; he then struck Dhananjaya with twelve arrows.

sa: पतितैर्निपतद्भिश्च गजैर्हेमविभूषितैः॥ अशोभत मही तत्र विशीर्णैरिव पर्वतैः।
en: With elephants adorned with gold fallen there the earth appeared as if strewn with shattered mountains.

sa: एवमुक्तो महाराज फाल्गुनेन महात्मना॥ उवाच दारुकं कृष्णः कुरुं सर्व यथाब्रवीत्। अर्जुनो भरतश्रेष्ठः श्रेष्ठः सर्वधनुष्मताम्॥
en: O sovereign, on being thus addressed by the magnanimous Phalguna, Krishna said to Daruka-"Do all that has been said by Arjuna, the foremost of archers and the best scion of Bharata's race."

sa: स तथा क्षिप्रकारी च दृढहस्तश्च पाण्डवः। प्रमोहं परमं गत्वा प्रेक्ष्य तं द्रोणजं ततः॥ विक्रम विहतं मेन आत्मनः स महायशाः। तस्यास्य समरे राजन् वपुरासीत् सुदुद्देशम्॥
en: Inspite of the dexterity and inflexibility of his hand, the son of Pandu, beholding the son of Drona, at the time, was greatly bewildered. And he (Arjuna) bethought himself of being deprived of his own prowess by that august personage (Ashvatthaman), whose bearing in the field, O king, presented a dazzling sight for human eyes.

sa: हतं जयद्रथं दृष्ट्वा तव पुत्रा नराधिप। दुःखादश्रूणि मुमुचुनिराशाश्चाभवञ्जये॥ ततो जयद्रथे राजन् हते पार्थेन केशवः।
en: Then beholding Jayadratha the ruler of the Sindhus's slain, tearing of sorrow gushed out from the eyes of your sons. Thereafter, O king, when Jayadratha had been slain by Pritha's son, Keshava.

sa: इति प्राज्ञः प्रज्ञयैतद् विचिन्त्य घटोत्कचं सूतपुत्रेण युद्धे। अधातयद् वासुदेवो नृसिंहः प्रियं कुर्वन् पाण्डवानाहितं च॥
en: Thinking in this way and for doing what was agreeable to the Pandavas that foremost of men Vasudeva, endued with great wisdom, had caused Ghatotkacha to be slain by Karna in battle.

sa: यत्र भोज्यं बहुविधं भक्ष्यं पेयं च पाण्डव। तत्र त्वं दुर्मते योग्यो न युद्धेषु कदाचन॥
en: O son of Pandu where there are various kinds of food and drink and edibles, that is really the place fit for you and not the field of battle, O wicked-souled one!

sa: दृष्ट्वा रथं मेघरवं ममैव समस्तसेना च रणेऽभ्यतिष्ठत्। तेषामहं पञ्च शतानि हत्वा ततो द्रौणिमगभं पार्थिवाग्र्य॥
en: Seeing my car rattling like a cloud, all the soldiers stood encircling it. Killing them all, who were full five hundred in number, I proceeded, O mightest of kings, against Drona's son.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच ततो दुर्योधनः सूत पश्चात् किमकरोत्तदा। यद्धोऽगमन्मनो मन्दाः कर्णं वैकर्तनं प्रति॥ अप्यपश्यत राधेयं शीतात इव भास्करम्।
en: Dhritarashtra said Thus when the minds of all you were turned towards Karna the son of Vikartana, did the warriors on my side look at the son of Radha, even as persons, oppressed with cold, look at the sun?

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा वचनं धृतराष्ट्रोऽम्बिकासुतः। भ्रान्तचित्तस्ततः सोऽथ बभूव जगतीपतिः॥
en: Having uttered these words, Dhritarashtra, the son of Ambika, that lord of down (upon the ground).

sa: अश्वत्थामानमासाद्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह॥ एष राजा महाबाहुरमर्षी क्रोधमूर्छितः।
en: Approaching Ashvatthama said these words-"This mighty-armed king, under the influence of rage and insensible with ire.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय नकुलः क्रोधमूर्छितः। सुषेणं नवभिर्बाणैर्वारयामास संयुगे॥
en: Then Nakula, beside himself with anger, took up another bow and withstood Sushena with nine arrows.

sa: ततोऽब्रुवन् कुरवः सर्व एव कर्णं दृष्ट्वा घोररूपां च मायाम्। शक्त्या रक्षो जहि कर्णाद्य तूर्णं नश्यन्त्येते कुरवो धार्तराष्ट्राः॥
en: At that time all the Kouravas, beholding Karna and the terrible the terrible illusion of the Rakshasas, cried out saying-O Karna, slay the Rakshasa with your dart. The Kouravas and the Dhritarashtras are on the point of being exterminated.

sa: यथा श्येनस्य पतनं वनेष्वामिषगृद्धिनः। तथैवासीदभीसारस्तस्य द्रोणं जिघांसतः॥ ततः शरशतेनास्य शतचन्द्रं समाक्षिपत्। द्रोणो दुपदपुत्रस्य खङ्गं च दशभिः शरैः॥
en: Looked that sally of Dhrishtadyumna from his own chariot, upon Drona, for his slaughter, Thereafter with a hundred shafts Drona cut-off the shield of Drupada's son, decked with hundred moons and then with another ten he cut-off nis sword.

sa: द्रौणिं संछादयामासुर्घनौघा इव भास्करम्। तथैव द्रौणिनिर्मुक्तैर्भीमः संनतपर्वभिः॥ अवाकीर्यत स क्षिप्रं शरैः शतसहस्रशः। स च्छाद्यमानः समरे द्रौणिना रणशालिना॥
en: Covered Drona's son like masses of clouds covering the Sun, Similarly Bhima also was quickly covered over with hundreds and thousands of arrows of depressed knots, shot by Drona's son. Covered in battle by Drona's son accomplished in battle.

sa: कर्णोऽपि निशितैर्बाणैर्विनिहत्य महाचमूम्॥ प्रमृद्य च रथश्रेष्ठान् युधिष्ठिरमपीडयत्।
en: Destroying that huge army with his sharpened arrows and assailing many leading car-warriors Karna afflicted Yudhishthira.

sa: सा प्रतिष्ठा तदमृतं लोकास्तद् ब्रह्म तद् यशः। भूतानि जज्ञिरे तस्मात् प्रलयं यान्ति तत्र हि॥
en: It is the foundation of everything; it is nectar; it is the universe; it is vast and delightful. From it are born all creatures and there do they come to their end.

sa: नास्मिन् कुले जातु ममज्ज धर्मो न चालस्यादर्थलोपो बभूव। अनुत्तराः सर्वभूतेषु भूयः सम्प्राप्ताः स्मः संशयं किं नु राजन्॥
en: "In our race virtue has never been sacrificed nor there has been any loss of wealth through idleness. Again, we have never refused anything to any creature. How is it, then, O king, that this disaster has befallen us?"

sa: इत्युक्तः प्रत्युवाचैनं प्रहसन्निव पाण्डवः। विनकर्ता मया वार्य इति मे व्रतमाहितम्॥ भ्रात्रा ज्येष्ठेन नृपते तवापि विदितं ध्रुवम्। प्रहरस्व यथाशक्ति न मन्युर्विद्यते मम॥
en: Thus addressed, the son of Pandu, smiling the while, answered him, saying, To resist him who obstructs me is the vow imposed on me by my eldest brother. Forsooth, O king, you know this. Do you strike me to the best of your power. I have no anger.

sa: नारद उवाच शाल्मले विपरीतं ते दर्शनं नात्र संशयः। न हि वायोर्बलेनास्ति भूतं तुल्यबलं क्वचित्॥
en: Narada said-O Shalmali, what you think seems to be quite the reverse of truth. There is no doubt in this. There is no created thing which is so strong as the Wind.

sa: देशकालेन संयुक्तं युद्धं विजयदं भवेत्। हीनकालं तदेवेह फलं न लभते पुनः। देशे काले च विक्रान्तं कल्याणाय विधीयते॥
en: It is only when undertaken in (proper) time and place that a battle produces success. This is not a favourable time and you will get no good fruit. Prowess, when manifested in proper hour and place, leads to well-being.

sa: धर्मात्मा पञ्चमश्चापि मित्रं नैकस्य न द्वयोः यतो धर्मस्ततो वा स्याद् धर्मस्थो वा ततो भवेत्॥
en: A righteous person, who would serve one and not both sides, is the fifth of the king's friends. Such a person follow that side on which righteousness is, and accordingly acts righteously.

sa: द्रोणकर्णी प्रतीयातां यदि भीष्मोऽपि वा रणे। महान् स्यात् संशयो लोके तत्र पश्यामि नो जयम्।९॥
en: Even if Drona, Karna or Bhishma advance against him in battle, there will befall a great calamity over the world. But I do not see even there any chance of our Victory.

sa: न बिभेति यदा चायं यदा चास्मान्न बिभ्यति। यदा नेच्छति न दृष्टि ब्रह्म सम्पद्यते तदा॥
en: When a person himself feels no fear and is feared by no one, when he has no desire and no hatred, he is then said to attain to the state of Brahima.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच केषां प्रभवते राजा वित्तस्य भरतर्षभ। कया च वृत्त्या वर्तेत तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Of whose wealth, O foremost of Bharata's race, is the king considered to be the master? And what conduct also should the king follow? Describe to me this, O grandfather!

sa: दह्यमाना महानागाः पेतुरुआं समन्ततः। नदन्तो भैरवान् नादाञ्जलदोपमनि:स्वनान्॥
en: Dreadfully scorched mighty elephants fell on the ground uttering terrible roars resembling the rumble of clouds.

sa: बहुशीर्षास्ततो नागाः शिरोभिर्जलसंततिम्। मुमुचुः पावकाभ्याशे सत्वराः क्रोधमूर्च्छिताः॥
en: Many-headed snakes, becoming mad with anger, speedily scattered on the fire water from their many hoods.

sa: तत्राप्यासादयामासुर्बकं नाम महाबलम्। पुरुषादं प्रतिभयं हिडिम्बेनैव सम्मितम्॥
en: Killed there a greatly strong man eating monster, named Baka, who was as terrible as Hidimba.

sa: तावुद्यतगदापाणी दुर्योधनवृकोदरौ॥ संयुगे च प्रकाशेतां गिरी सशिखराविव।
en: Duryodhana and Bhima, with uplifted maces, shone in that battle like two mountains with tall sumınits.

sa: तस्मादनुज्ञां सम्प्राप्य जगाम पितरं प्रति॥ सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं कृष्णद्वैपायनं मुनिम्। शुकः प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा कृष्णमापृष्टवान् मुनिम्॥
en: Obtaining Narada's permission, Shuka then went to where his father was. Arrived before him, the great Muni, viz., the great and Islandborn Krishna, Shuka circumambulated him and addressed him the usual enquiries.

sa: त्रीणि कल्पसहस्राणि एतेषामहरुच्यते॥ रात्रिरेतावती चैव मनसश्च नराधिप। मनश्चरति राजेन्द्र चारितं सर्वमिन्द्रियैः :॥ न चेन्द्रियाणि पश्यन्ति मन एवानुपश्यति।
en: Three thousands of Kalpas form their day. Their night also is the same. The Mind roves over all things, O king, guided by the Senses. The Senses do not perceive anything. It is the Mind that perceives through them.

sa: ब्रह्मा नारायणश्चैव देवराजश्च कौशिकः॥ अशोभन्त महात्मानस्त्रयस्त्रय इवाग्नयः।
en: Verily, Brahman and Narayana and Shakra, those three great gods shone there like three sacrificial fires.

sa: रमणीयैर्वनोद्देशैस्तत्र तत्र विभूषितम्। तत्राश्रमपदं दिव्यं ददर्श भगवानथ॥
en: There were many charming groves in the forest. The illustrious Rishi then saw a beautiful asylum.

sa: धर्म उवाच यदि त्वं नेच्छसे त्यक्तुं शरीरं पश्य वै द्विजा एष कालस्तथा मृत्युर्यमश्च त्वामुपागताः॥
en: Dharma said If you do not wish to cast off your body, behold O twice-born one, there is Time, and there is Mrityu, and there is Yama, who are all approaching you.

sa: ततः सलिलमुत्पन्नं तमसीवापरं तमः। तस्माच्च सलिलोत्पीडादुदतिष्ठत मारुतः॥
en: Then water originated like something darker within darkness. Then from the pressure of water sprang wing.

sa: तस्मिन् हतेऽथ स्वं भावं प्रत्यपद्यन्त मानवाः। प्रापद्यन्त च वेदान् वै शास्त्राणि च यथा पुरा॥
en: When this king of the Asuras was killed men once more gained their proper natures, and once more began to study the Vedas and the other scriptures as in days of yore.

sa: भृगुरुवाच न प्रणाशोऽस्ति जीवस्य दत्तस्य च कृतस्य च। याति देहान्तरं प्राणी शरीरं तु विशीर्यते॥
en: Bhrigu said The living creature, or what is given, or our other acts, are never destroyed. The death of a creature is only a change of form. The body alone is dissolved.

sa: कर्मणः फलनिर्वृत्तिं स्वयमश्नाति कारकः। प्रत्यक्षं दृश्यते लोके कृतस्यापकृतस्य च॥ शुभेन कर्मणा सौख्यं दुःखं पापेन कर्मणा। कृतं फलति सर्वत्र नाकृतं भुज्यते क्वचित्॥
en: It is seen every day in the world that the doer reaps the fruit of his good and evil acts; that happiness results from goods deeds, and pain is the outcome of evil ones; that acts, when done, always fructify; and that, if not done, no fruit arises.

sa: द्वे चायुते नरश्रेष्ठ वायवाहारा महामते। पुनरेव ततो राजन् मौनमातिष्ठदुत्तमम्॥ अप्सु वर्षसहस्राणि सप्त चैकं च पार्थिवा ततो जगाम सा कन्या कौशिकी नृपसत्तम॥
en: And once more, O foremost of men, she passed twenty thousand years living upon air only. Once again, O king she observed the excellent vow of silence for eight thousand years passing the whole period in water. Then that maiden, O best of kings, went to river Kaushiki.

sa: पार्थ मुचुकुन्दो नराधिपः। भार्गवं परिपप्रच्छ प्रणतः पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: This very question, O son of Pritha, had been put humbly to Bhrigu's son by Muchukunda.

sa: सर्वः स्वे स्वे गृहे राजा सर्वः स्वे स्वे गृहे गृही। निग्रहानुग्रहान् कुर्वंस्तुल्यो जनक राजभिः॥
en: Then again all men are kings in their own houses. All men, again, in their own houses are householders. Like kings, O Janaka, all men in their own houses punish and reward.

sa: कथं शक्ष्यामहे ब्रह्मन् दानवैरभिमर्दनम्। स्वयम्भूस्तानुवाचेदं निसृष्टोऽत्र विधिर्मया॥
en: The self-create answered them, saying,-I have already ordained what is to be done in this matter.

sa: शूद्रे चैतद्भवेल्लक्ष्यं द्विजे तच्च न विद्यते। न वै शूद्रो भवेच्छूद्रो ब्राह्मणो न च ब्राह्मणः॥
en: If these marks are not seen in a Shudra, and if they are not seen in a Brahmana, then such a Shudra is no Shudra, and such a Brahmana is no Brahmana.

sa: उभे तु यस्य सदृशे भवेतां किंस्वित्तयोस्तत्र जयोथ न स्यात्। आचक्ष्व नः पुण्यपैलं महर्षे कथं पापं नुदते धर्मशीलः।।३३।
en: Can not that person free himself from both virtue and sin who regards the two (happiness and inisery) equally? Tell us, O great Rishi, what are the fruits of righteousness, and how does a virtuous person remove his sins!

sa: नाचिकेताय भगवानाह वैवस्वतो यमः। मार्कण्डेयाय वार्ष्णेय नाचिकेतोऽभ्यभाषत॥
en: Vaivasvat Yana communicated it to Nachiketa. Nachiketa, O you of Vrishni's race, communicated it to Markandeya.

sa: सुखमेव तु कर्तव्यं सकृत् कृत्वा सुखं मम। यावदन्तं च मे सौख्यं जात्यां जात्यां भविष्यति॥
en: Through Ignorance Individual Soul thinks,-I should secure my happiness. By continually doing good deeds, I may enjoy happiness in this life till its close and shall be happy in all future lives.

sa: श्वेतद्वीपानिवृत्तश्च नारदः परमेष्ठिजः॥ बदरीमाश्रमं प्राप्य समागम्य च तावृषी। कियन्तं कालमवसत् प्रश्नान् कान् पृष्टवांश्च ह॥ श्वेतद्वीपादुपावृत्ते तस्मिन् वा सुमहात्मनि। किमब्रूतां महात्मानौ नरनारायणावृषी॥ तदेतन्मे यथातत्त्वं सर्वमाख्यातुमर्हसि।
en: How long also did Narada the son of Prameshthi, after his return from White Island and arrival at Vadari and meeting with the two Rishis Nara and Narayana, reside there, and what conversation had he with them? What did those two great and foremost of Rishis say to him? You should tell me all this.

sa: भीष्म उवाच श्रूयतां भरतश्रेष्ठ यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि। प्रजानां पतयो येऽस्मिन् दिक्षु ये चर्षयः स्मृताः॥
en: 'Hear me, O chief of the Bharatas, about what you ask. I shall tell you who the Patriarchs were and what Rishis are mentioned as living on which points of the horizon.

sa: ततस्य देववचनान्मणिभद्रो महामनाः। पतितं भूमौ कुण्डधार किमिष्यते॥
en: At the command of the gods the Manibhadra said to the prostrate Kundadhara,-What does Kundadhara want?

sa: न त्वं स्मरसि वारुण्या लट्वाकानां च पक्षिणाम्। ताभ्यां चाभ्यधिको भक्ष्यो न कश्चिद् विद्यते क्वचित्।।
en: You have no idea of the taste of the wine called Varuni or of the meat of the birds called Ladvaka. There is no drink and no so food sweeter than these.

sa: भरतश्चापि दौष्यन्तिर्लेभे भूमिशयादसिम्॥ तस्माल्लेभे च धर्मज्ञो राजन्नैलविलस्तथा।
en: Bhumishaya gave it to Dhushmanta's son Bharata. Bharata, O king, gave it to the righteous Ailavila.

sa: नास्ति मत्तोऽधिः कश्चित् को वान्योऽयॊ मया स्वयम् को वा मम पिता लोके अहमेव पितामहः॥
en: There is no one that is superior to me. Who is there whom I myself may adore with rites? Who, again, is iny father in the universe? I myself am my grandfather.

sa: कुन्ती च द्रौपदी चैव सात्वती च यशस्विनी। उलूपी नागकन्या च देवी चित्राङ्गदा तथा॥ धृष्टकेतोश्च भगिनी जरासंधसुता तथा। एताश्चान्याश्च बह्वयो वै योषितः पुरुषर्षभ।॥ किंकराः पर्युपातिष्ठन् सर्वाः सुबलजां तथा। यथा पुत्रवियुक्तोऽयं न किंचिद् दुःखमाप्नुयात्॥ इति तानन्वशाद् भ्रातॄन् नित्यमेव युधिष्ठिरः। एवं ते धर्मराजस्य श्रुत्वा वचनमर्थवत्॥
en: Kunti, Draupadi, and she of the Sattwata race possessed of great fame, and ulupi the daughter of the Naga king, and queen Chitrangada, and the sister of Dhrishtaketu, and the daughter of Jarasandha, these and many other ladies, O king, used to wait upon the daughter of Subala like maids of all work. Yuthishthira always enjoined upon his bothers that Dhritarashtra, who was deprived of all his children, might not feel himself unhappy in any way. They also, on their part, listening to these pregnant commands from king Yudhishthira, showed particular obedience to the old king.

sa: कृत्वा कर्माणि पापानि कथं यान्ति शुभां गतिम्। कर्मणा च कृतेनेह केन यान्ति शुभां गतिम्॥
en: Having committed various sinful deeds, by what acts do people succeed in acquiring an auspicious end in this world? By what acts also, do people acquire auspicious end in the celestial region?

sa: धर्मो विवर्धति भृगोः परिकीर्तनेन वीर्यं विवर्धति वसिष्ठनमोनतेन। संग्रामजिद् भवति चैव रघु नमस्यन्। स्यादश्विनौ च परिकीर्तयतो न रोगः।।
en: By reciting the name of Bhrigu, one's virtue becomes enhances. By bowing to Vasishtha, one's energy becomes enhanced. By bowing to Raghu, one becomes victorious in battle. By reciting the praises of the Ashvins, one becomes freed from diseases.

sa: भीष्म उवाच यथा श्राद्धं सम्प्रवृत्तं यस्मिन् काले यदात्मकम्। येन संकल्पितं चैव तन्मे शृणु जनाधिप॥
en: Bhishma said Listen to me, O kine, as I tell you how the Shraddha was introduced, the time of such introduction, the essence of the rite, and the ascetic who conceived it.

sa: न हि प्राणात् प्रियतरं लोके किंचन विद्यते। तस्माद् दयां नरः कुर्याद् यथाऽऽत्मनि तथा परे॥
en: In this world there is nothing that is dearer to a creature than his life. Hence, one should show mercy to the lives of others as he does to his own life.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य धर्मात्मन् धर्माः प्रोक्ता यथा त्वया। तथैव मे श्राद्धविधिं कृत्स्नं प्रब्रूहि पार्थिव॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have described to me, you of righteous soul, the duties of the four castes. Do you, similarly, O king, describe to me now all the ordinances regarding the Shraddha.

sa: अत्र गाथा: कामगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। शृणु संकीर्त्यमानास्ता अखिलेन युधिष्ठिर। नाहं शक्योऽनुपायेन हन्तुं भूतेन केनचित्॥
en: As an illustration of this truth, the sages, well-read in ancient learning, recite these verses called by the name of Kamagita, do you, Yudhishthira, listen to the recital of them in full.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं स राजा कुरुवृद्धवर्यः समागतस्तैर्नरदेवपुत्रैः पप्रच्छ सर्वं कुशलं तदानीं गतेषु सर्वेष्वथ तापसेषु॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thus that aged king of Kuru's race, having met with those sons of him that was a celestial among men, enquired about their well-being after all the ascetics had departed.

sa: ततो दुःखमनुप्राप्य बहु वर्षगणानिह। अपुनर्भवसंयुक्तस्तत: कूर्मः प्रजायते॥
en: Having suffered misery for a great many years, he has to take birth as hairless tortoise.

sa: धर्नामर्थ्य च काम्यं च काले चाभिहितं वचः। न प्रतीयन्ति ते नूनं तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Indeed, your acts connected with Virtue. Profit, and Pleasure, as also the well-time words spoken by you do not produce fruit. It is for this that you are so pale and lean,

sa: इदं चापि शरीरं मे तवायत्तं जनाधिप। धनानि चेति विद्धि त्वं न मे तत्रास्ति संशयः॥
en: Let him be told besides, 'O monarch this very body of mine is at your disposal, and all the riches I have! Know this and let there be no doubt in this.

sa: ततश्चित्राङ्गदा देवी कौरव्यम्यात्मजापि च। पृथां कृष्णां च सहिते विनयेनोपजग्मतु॥ सुभद्रां च यथान्यायं याश्चान्याः कुरुयोषितः।
en: Then queen Chitrangada, and (Ulupi) the daughter of (the snake) Kauravya, together humbly approached Pritha and Krishna. They then met Subhadra and the other ladies of the Kuru race with due formalities.

sa: नारद उवाच नासौ वृथाग्निना दग्धो यथा तत्र श्रुतं मया। वैचित्रवीर्यो नृपतिस्तत् ते वक्ष्यामि सुव्रत॥
en: Narada said The king has not been burnt to death by an unsanctified fire. I have heard this there. I tell you, O Bharata, such has not been the fate of Vaichitravirya.

sa: भवता तत्कृतं कर्म येनावाप्तो जयो मया। दुर्योधनस्य संग्रामे तव बुद्धिपराक्रमैः॥ कर्णस्य च वधोपायो यथावत् सम्प्रदर्शितः। सैन्धवस्य च पापस्य भूरिश्रवस एव च॥
en: That feat was achieved by you on account of which victory became mine! By the power of your intelligence was shown the ineans by which was duly effected the destruction of Duryodhana in battle, as also of Karna, as of the sinful king of the Sindhus, and Bhurishravas.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच एके लोकाः सुकृतिनः सर्वे त्वाहो पितामह। तत्र तत्रापि भिन्नास्ते तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said O grandfather, it has been said that all righteous men attain to the same region after death. It is true, O Bharata, that there is difference of position among them?

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अकामाश्च सकामाश्च ये हताः स्म महामृधे। कां गतिं प्रतिपन्नास्ते तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Yudhishthira said Wishing to die and wishing to live many persons surrender their lives in the great sacrifice (of battle). Tell me O grandfather what is the end that these attain to.

sa: य एव विष्णु: सोऽनन्तो भगवान् वसुधाधरः । यो राम: स हृषीकेशो योऽच्युतः स धराधरः॥
en: He is Vishnu, He is the illustrious Ananta. He is the supporter of the Earth. He who is Rama is Hrishikesha. He who is Achyuta is Ananta the bearer of the Earth.

sa: भीष्म उवाच ततः सर्वे महाभाग देवाश्च पितरश्च ह। ऋषयश्च महाभागाः प्रमथान् वाक्यमब्रुवन्॥ भवन्तो वै महाभागा अपरोक्षनिशाचराः। उच्छिष्टानशुचीन् क्षुद्रान् कथं हिंसथ मानवान्॥
en: Bhishma said Then all the highly blessed celestials and the departed Manes, and the highly blessed Rishis also, addressing the Pramathas, said, Ye are all highly blessed beings. Ye are invincible right rangers. Why do you afflict those men who are vile and impure and that are unclean?

sa: अतितेजस्विनः सर्वे महावीर्या महागजाः। घरयन्ति महीं कृत्स्नां सशैलवनकाननाम्॥ भवद्भिः समनुज्ञातो रेणुकस्तान् महागजान्। धर्मगुह्यानि सर्वाणि गत्वा पृच्छतु तत्र वै॥ पितामहवचः श्रुत्वा ते देवा रेणुकं तदा। प्रेषयामासुरव्यग्रा यत्र ते धरणीधराः॥
en: Those powerful elephants of great energy and power, who hold the entire Earth with her hills, waters and lakes, should be seen by this Renuka at your request. Let Renuka go to them and ask them about the mysteries of religion or duty! Hearing these words of the Grandfather, the celestials wellpleased, sent (the elephant) Renuka to where those upholders of the world are.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच के पूज्या वै त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन् मानवा भरतर्षभ। विस्तरेण तदाचक्ष्व न हि तृप्यामि कथ्यतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said What men, O chief of Bharata's race are worthy of homage in the three worlds? Tell me this in detail, I am never satiated with hearing you describe these topics.

sa: संवर्त उवाच कथमस्मि त्वया ज्ञातः केन वा कथितोऽस्मि ते। एतदाचक्ष्व मे तत्त्वमिच्छसे चेन्मम प्रियम्॥
en: How nave you come to know me, and who has referred you to ine, do you tell this to me truly, if you desire me to do what is good to you.

sa: गङ्गाकूले मया दृष्टस्तापसैः परिवारितः। स तानामन्त्र्य तेजस्वी निवेद्येतच्च सर्वशः॥ प्रययौ संजयो धीमान् हिमवन्तं महीधरम्।
en: I saw him on the banks of Ganga in the midst of ascetics. Gifted with great, energy and great intelligence's he bade them farewell and then started for the mountains of Himavat.

sa: धर्मार्थकामैर्विपुलैयुज्यते सह नित्यशः॥ लोकांश्च लभते पुण्यान् विश्वेश्वरकृताञ्छुभान्।
en: One acquires hereafter diverse regions of auspiciousness and happiness created by the Lord of the universe.

sa: तस्मात् प्राणिषु सर्वेषु दयावानात्मवान् भवेत्॥ सर्वमांसानि यो राजन् यावज्जीवं न भक्षयेत्। स्वर्गे स विपुलं स्थानं प्राप्नुयानात्र संशयः॥ ये भक्षयन्ति मांसानि भूतानां जीवितैषिणाम्। भक्ष्यन्ते तेऽपि भूतैस्तैरिति मे नास्ति संशयः॥ मांसं भक्षयते यस्माद् भक्षयिष्ये तमप्यहम्। एतन्मांसस्य मांसत्वमनुबुद्ध्यस्व भारत।॥ घातको वध्यते नित्यं तथा वध्यति भक्षिता।
en: are Hence, a person of purified soul should be merciful to all living creatures. That man, O king, who abstains from every kinds of meat from his birth, forsooth, acquires a large space in the celestial region. They who eat the flesh of animals who are desirous of life. are themselves eaten by the animals they eat. This is my opinion. Since he has eaten me, I shall eat him in return, this O Bharata, forms the character as Mansa of Mansa. The destroyer is always slain. After him the eater meets with the same fate.

sa: पतिप्रसादः स्वर्गो वा तुल्यो नार्या न वा भवेत्। अहं स्वर्ग न हीच्छेयं त्वय्यप्रीते महेश्वरे।॥
en: A woman considers husband's grace and Heaven as equal; or, if unequal the inequality is very trivial. O Maheshvara 1 do not wish Heaven itself if you are not satisfied with me.

sa: गुणेभ्यः पञ्चभूतानि एष भूतसमुच्छ्रय:॥ देवा मनुष्या गन्धर्वाः पिशाचासुरराक्षसाः। सर्वे स्वभावतः सृष्टा न क्रियाभ्यो न कारणात्॥ एते विश्वसृजो विप्रा जायन्तीह पुनः पुनः।
en: After the qualities (are dissolved) the five elements. Such is the gradation of entities. Celestials, men, Gandharvas, Pishachas, Asuras, (and) Rakshasa, have all originated from Nature, and not from actions, nor from a cause. The Brahmanas, who are creators of the universe are born here again and again.

sa: इमान् देवगणांस्तात प्रजापतिगणांस्तथा। ऋषींचापि महाभाग परित्रायस्व पावक॥
en: O sire, do you rescue these celestials, these Prajapatis, and these Rishis, O highly blessed Pavaka.

sa: यानि कानि च दुर्गाणि दुष्कृतानि कृतानि च। तरन्ति चैव पाप्मानं धेनुं ये ददति प्रभो॥
en: They who make gifts of kine succeed in getting over all sins which they may have committed and all kinds of dangers into which they may fall, O you of great power.

sa: घडजर्षभः स गान्धारो मध्यमः पञ्चमस्तथा। अतः परं तु विज्ञेयो निषादो धैवतस्तथा। अष्टश्चानिष्टशब्दश्च संहतः प्रविभागवान्॥
en: Shadaja, Rishabha, together with Gandhara, Madhyama, and likewise Panchama; after this should be known Nishada, and then Daivata, besides these, there are agreeable sounds and disagreeable sounds compact, and of many ingredients.

sa: वसिष्ठ उवाच भरेऽसुतान् भरेऽशिष्यान् भरे देवान् भरे द्विजान्। भरे भार्यों भरे द्वाजं भरद्वाजोऽस्मि शोभने॥
en: Bharadvaja said I always support my sons, my disciples, the celestials, the Brahmanas, and my wife. On account of my thus supporting all with ease, I pass by the name of Bharadvaja.

sa: त्वया वृद्धो मम पिता भगदत्तः पितुः सखा। हतो वृद्धो मम पिता शिशुं मामद्य योधय॥
en: My aged father Bhagadatta, who was the friend of your father, was killed by you on account of his weight of years. Do you, however, fight me who am but a boy.

sa: न ते परिभवः कार्यो गवामसुरसूदन॥ एतच्छ्रुत्वा सहस्राक्षः पूजयामास नित्यदा। गाश्चक्रे बहुमानं च तासु नित्यं युधिष्ठिर॥ एतत् ते सर्वमाख्यातं पावनं च महाद्युते। पवित्रं परमं चापि गवां माहात्म्युमुत्तमम्॥ कीर्तितं पुरुषव्याघ्र सर्वपापविमोचनम्। य इदं कथयेन्नित्यं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समाहितः॥ हव्यकव्येष यज्ञेषु पितृकार्येषु चैव ह। सार्वकामिकमक्षय्यं पितृस्तस्योपतिष्ठते॥
en: I have thus told you everything about the purifying character of kine, O you of great splendour. I have expounded to you the sacred and high pre-eminence and glory of kine, that is capable of purifying one from every sin, O chief of men. That man who with senses withdrawn from every other object will recite this account to Brahmanas, on occasions when Havya and Kavya are offered, or at sacrifices, or on occasions of worshipping the departed in succeeds conferring upon his ancestors an endless happiness fraught with the fruition of every desire.

sa: सम्मतः सर्वभूतानां सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः। स्वकर्मफलमाप्नोति स्वयमेव नरः सदा॥
en: Honoured of all creatures and receiving their respect, he obtains the fruits of his own deeds.

sa: श्रुत्वा तद् वचनं क्रूरमात्मापहरणोपमम्॥ वैदेही शोकसंतप्ता हुताशनमुपागमत्।
en: Hearing these cruel words, like to loss of life, Vaidehi, burning in grief, approached the Fire.

sa: पितर ऊचुः नार्हसे क्षत्रबन्धुंस्त्वं निहन्तुं जयतां वरा नेह युक्तं त्वया हन्तुं ब्राह्मणेन सता नृपान्॥
en: The departed manes then said, O foremost of all victorious men, you should not kill these inferior Kshatriyas! It is not proper that your self, being a Brahmanas should kill these kings.

sa: ज्वलन्ती भासमाना च तेजसा स्वेन भारत। तामुग्रतपसो यान्ति सुव्रताः सत्यवादिनः॥ शान्ताः संन्यासिनः शुद्धाः पूताः पुण्येन कर्मणा। सर्वे भास्वरदेहाश्च सर्वे च विरजोऽम्बराः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, it is resplendent with its own effulgence. It is visited by the ascetics of severe penances, of excellent vows, of truthful speech, of pure and peaceful mind, and of heart sanctified by holy deeds, all of shining bodies and all attired in spotless robes,

sa: मानुषाणामधिपतिं देवभूतं सनातनम्। देवापि नावमन्यन्ते धर्मकामं नरेश्वरम्॥
en: The very gods do not disobey a virtuous king who is truly a personification of god.

sa: न मातुलं च स्वस्रीयो न सखायं सखा तथा। आविष्टा इव युद्धयन्ते पाण्डवाः कुरुभिः सह॥
en: The maternal uncle did not recognise his sister's son, and the friend did not recognise the friend. the Pandava and the Kuru forces fought as if they had been possessed by demons.

sa: इक्ष्वाकोस्तु नरव्याघ्र पुत्रः परमधार्मिकः॥ अलम्बुषायामुत्पन्नो विशाल इति विश्रुतः। तेन चासीदिह स्थाने विशालेति पुरी कृता॥
en: O most powerful of men, Ikşvāku had an exceedingly righteous son born to him of Alambusa, known by the name of Viśāla. And here stood a palace, built by him, called Viśālā.

sa: अग्निहोत्रनिकेतेषु वास्तुमध्येषु वेश्मसु। वृष्ण्यन्धकानखादन्त स्वप्ने गृध्रा भयानकाः॥
en: The men dreamt that dreadful vultures, entering their houses and fire-chambers, gorged themselves on their bodies.

sa: भो उत्तकैतत्पुरीषमस्य ऋषभस्य भक्षयस्वेति स एवमुक्तो नैच्छत्॥
en: "O Uttanka, eat the dung of this bull." But Uttanka was not willing to eat it.

sa: इति चिन्तयतस्तस्य निमित्तान्युपपेदिरे। पूर्वमप्युपलब्धानि साक्षात् पुनरचिन्तयत् ॥
en: As he was reflecting thus, he bethought him of auspicious omens which he had witnessed since.

sa: यथा हि पूर्वेऽहनि धर्मराज्ञा व्यूहः कृतः कौरवसत्तमेन। तथा न भूतो भुवि मानुषेषु न दृष्टपूर्वो न च संश्रुतश्च॥
en: This Vyuha of today was like the one which was formed on the day previous by that foremost of Kurus, king Dharamraja Yudhishthira and the like of which had never been seen or heard to before by any man.

sa: वीराश्च नियतोत्साहा राजशास्त्रमनुष्ठिताः। शुचीनां रक्षितारश्च नित्यं विषयवासिनाम्॥
en: And they were heroic, and ever high-spirited, following policy, and protecting those citizens that were pure.

sa: ततो गच्छेतधर्मज्ञ दधीचस्य महात्मनः॥ तीर्थं पुण्यतमं राजन् पावनं लोकविश्रुतम्। यत्र सारस्वतो यातः सोऽङ्गिरास्तपसो निधिः॥
en: O virtuous man, one should then go to the illustrious Dadhichi's sacred Tirtha called Pavana, celebrated all over the world. Here was born that ocean of asceticism, Angiras, of the Sarasvata race.

sa: प्रावर्तन्ताथ देवानामुत्पाताभयशंसिनः। इन्द्रस्य वज्रं दयितं प्रजज्वाल भयात्ततः॥
en: Various evil omens appeared before the celestial foreboding fear. Indra's thunder-bolt blazed up in a fright.

sa: ततः पश्यन्त्वमुं दीनमङ्गवैरूप्यकर्शितम्। सुमित्रज्ञातयः सर्वे बान्धवाः ससुहृज्जनाः॥
en: Then shall his best friends and kindred and acquaintances see him crest-fallen, with his person deformed.

sa: यस्तु देशः प्रियस्तस्य जीवतोऽभून्महात्मनः। तत्रैनमुपसंकल्प्य पितृमेधं प्रचक्रिरे॥
en: The last rites were then performed at that spot which he liked while he was alive

sa: संजय उवाच इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः। आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा॥
en: Sanjaya said Having said all this to Arjuna, Vasudeva once more showed him his own ordinary form. The high-souled One, once more assuming his gentle form, comforted Arjuna who was much agitated.

sa: संजय उवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी। मनस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं सगद्गद भीतभीतः प्रणम्य॥
en: Sanjaya said Hearing these words the diadem decked Arjuna, trembling, and with joined hands, bowed to Krishna. Making his salutations, overwhelmed with fear, he once more with choked voice said to him.

sa: विश्वकर्मकृता चास्य दिव्या माला हिरण्मयी॥ आबद्धा त्रिपुरघ्नेन स्वयमेव यशस्विना। आगम्य मनुजव्याघ्र सह देव्या परंतप॥
en: O foremost of men, that illustrious deity, the vanquisher of Tripura (Indra) Lord Shiva with his wife came there and put round his neck the celestial garland of gold mady by Vishwakarma.

sa: स देशान् विविधान् पश्यंश्चीनहूणनिषेवितान्। आर्यावर्तमिमं देशमाजगाम महामुनिः॥
en: Having seen many countries inhabited by Chins and Huns, the great ascetic at last reached Aryavarta.

sa: नैव रथः रणे रणेऽभिमानी च विमुखश्चापि दृश्यते। घृणी कर्णः प्रमादी च तेन मेऽर्धरथो मतः॥
en: In each battle is he boastful and in each he is seen to be backward. Karna is kind and also becomes confounded; he is therefore in my opinion, to half a Ratha."

sa: तस्मात् क्षिप्रं मद्रपते प्रयाहि रणे पञ्चालान् पाण्डवान् सृञ्जयांश्च। तान् वा हनिष्यामि समेत्य संख्ये यास्यामि वा द्रोणपथा यमाय॥
en: Therefore, O king of Madra, move on quickly in this battle towards the Panchalas, Pandavas and Srinjayas. Encountering them either I will kill them or will myself go to the abode of death by the road followed by Drona.

sa: संकटेऽप्यस्य सुमहान् विवरो जायतेऽधिकः। ऋतुपर्णस्य चार्थाय भोजनीयमनेकशः॥ प्रेषितं तत्र राज्ञा तु मांसं चैव प्रभूतवत्। तस्य प्रक्षालनार्थाय कुम्भास्तत्रोपकल्पिताः॥
en: Thus a small hole grows largely wide at his coming. There were sent by the king (Bhima) various sorts of food, as also flesh of many animals, for Rituparna. There were also many vessels sent for washing the flesh.

sa: प्राज्ञस्य मूढस्य च जीवितान्ते नास्ति प्रमोक्षोऽन्तकसत्कृतस्य। अतो विद्वन्नभियास्यामि पार्थान् दिष्टं न शक्यं व्यतिवर्तितुं वै॥
en: A wise man or an ignorant person, none can escape death, when the lease of his life expires. Therefore, O learned one. I shall proceed against Partha. I cannot transgress my destiny.

sa: वध्यमानास्ततस्तैस्तु हयैस्तेन रथेन च। अगमन् प्रक्षयं केचित्र्यवर्तन्त तथा परे॥ स्पर्धमाना इवास्माभिर्निवातकवचा रणे। शरवर्षेः शरार्तं मां महद्भिः प्रत्यवारयन्॥
en: Then, some (of the Danavas) crushed by the horses and the car, met with destruction and some gave up fighting; while others, in the encounter, challenged by us and afflicted with arrows, opposed me by heavy downpour of shafts.

sa: यस्मात् तव भयं सौम्यं पूर्वजात् पापकर्मणः। स नेह वाली दुष्टात्मा न ते पश्याम्यहं भयम्॥
en: I do not observe here, O gentle one, the wicked-souled Väli your elder brother of impious actions and whom you do fear and I do not perceive any terror proceeding from him.

sa: मासि प्रौष्ठपदे ब्रह्म ब्राह्मणानां विवक्षताम्। अयमध्यायसमयः सामगानामुपस्थितः॥
en: This month of Bhādra is the time of studying for those Brahmins, who chant Sāma Vedas.

sa: तौ सोस्पृशन्तौ चरणावुत्थाप्य मुनिपुंगवः। गाढमाश्लिष्य सस्नेहमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said this, Rāghava along with Sītā and Sumitrā's son bowed down to the ascetic's feet.

sa: कुलिन्दास्तङ्गणाम्बष्ठा पैशाचाश्च सबर्बराः। पर्वतीयाश्च राजेन्द्र क्रुद्धा: पाषाणपाणयः॥
en: Kulindas, Tanganas, Amvartas, Pisachas, Barbaras and mountaineers, Oking, all inspired with rage and armed with stones.

sa: ता वयं सहिताः सर्वास्त्वत्सकाशे प्रजेश्वर। वत्स्यामो नियताहारस्तपश्चरणतत्पराः॥
en: All of us, therefore, O Lord of creatures, shall live in your house practising austere penances."

sa: षट्पञ्चाशतमष्टौ च सप्तत्रिंशतमित्युत॥ यस्मिशाखा यजुर्वेदे सोऽहमाध्वर्यवे स्मृतः।
en: In the Adhyaryus I am sung as the YajurVeda of fifty-six and fifteen and thirty branches.

sa: त्यज शोकं च मोहं च भयं च हृदये स्थितम्। त्वया विधानं हर्यग्र्य न शक्यमतिवर्तितुम्॥
en: Do you therefore renounce your grief, your illusion and the fear that is lurking in your heart. It is impossible for you, O foremost of monkeys, to withstand the course of dispensation.

sa: ततो रम्भस्त्वनुप्राप्तस्तरुणादित्यसंनिभः॥ अयुतेन वृतश्चैव सहस्रेण शतेन च।
en: Then followed Rambha, resembling the infant sun, accompanied by an ayuta, a thousand, and an hundred.

sa: एतदेवाश्रमपदं नूनं तस्य महात्मनः। अगस्त्यस्य मुनेतुर्दृश्यते पुण्यकर्मणः॥
en: 'Surely we see the asylumn of that high-souled one, the ascetic, Agastya's brother of pious acts.

sa: कौशिकस्तु तथेत्याह राजा चाभाष्य मन्त्रिणः। अयोध्यां प्रेषयामास धर्मात्मा कृतशासनान्। यतावृत्तं समाख्यातुमानेतुं च नृपं तथा॥
en: And thereupon Kusika's son said,-So be it. And the righteous king, summoning his counsellors, despatched them to Ayodhyā with his letter, to communicate all duly to the king, and bring him thither.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु संरब्धः शरानाशीविषोपमान्॥ त्रिशोरोवक्षसि क्रुद्धो निजघान चतुर्दश।
en: Saying this, (Rāma) enraged, and influenced by wrath, wounded Trisiră in the breast with fourteen arrows.

sa: निर्ययौ प्राप्य सुग्रीवो राज्यश्रियमनुत्तमाम्। स वानरशतैस्तीक्ष्णैर्बहुभिः शस्त्रपाणिभिः॥
en: And surrounded by hundreds of high-spirited apes and armed people, he proceeded whither Rāma was staying.

sa: ततः सुवेषं मृगयागतं पति प्रतीक्षमाणा सहलक्ष्मणं तदा। निरीक्षमाणा हरितं ददर्श तन्महद्वनं नैव तु रामलक्ष्मणौ॥
en: She was anxiously expecting the return of Rāma who had gone a-hunting with Lakşmaņa; she looked around and beheld but on all sides the spacious yellow forest-land-~-there was neither Rāma nor Lakşmaņa.

sa: तवादर्शनशोकेन राघवः परिचाल्यते। महता भूमिकम्पेन महानिव शिलोच्चयः॥
en: Rāghava is moved by your separation like to a huge mountain shaken by a terrible earth-quake.

sa: जनकस्य वचः श्रुत्वा पाणीन्पाणिभिरस्पृशन्॥ चत्वारस्ते चतसृणां वसिष्ठस्य मते स्थिताः। अग्नि प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा वेदिं राजानमेव च॥ ऋषींश्चापि महात्मानः सहभार्या रघूद्वाहाः। यथोक्तेन ततश्चक्रुर्विवाहं विधिपूर्वकम्॥ पुष्पवृष्टिर्महत्यासीदन्तरिक्षात् सुभास्वरा।
en: Hearing Janaka's speech, those four perpetuators of Raghus's line, staying by Vasiştha's opinions, taking the hands of the four brides with their own, went round the sacrificial fire, and the dais, and the king, and the highsouled saints; and in company with their wives, agreeably to direction entered into matrimony in accordance with the ordinance.

sa: अथ दीर्पण कालेन रूपयौवनशालिनः। षष्ठिः पुत्रसहस्राणि सगरस्याभवंस्तदा॥
en: And after a long lapse of time, Sagara's sixty thousand sons attained to youth and beauty.

sa: सर्वसीमन्तिनीभ्यश्च सीतां सीमन्तिनी वराम्॥ अमन्यन्त हि ता नार्यो रामस्य हृदयप्रियाम्। तया सुचरितं देव्या पुरा नूनं महत् तपः॥ रोहिणीव शशाङ्केन रामसंयोगमाप या।
en: Those ladies thought that Sītā, the captivater of Rāma's heart was surely the best of all women and for certain had she performed some great austerities in her past life or else she would not have been the companion of Răma, like to Rohini, the companion of Moon.

sa: न चाहृष्यन् न चामोदन् वणिजो न प्रसारयन्। न चाशोभन्त पण्यानि नापचन् गृहमेधिनः॥ नष्टं दृष्ट्वा नाभ्यनन्दन विपुलं वा धनागमम्। पुत्रं प्रथमजं लब्ध्वा जननी नाप्यनन्दत ॥
en: They forgot to rejoice or make merry, and the traders did not spread (their stores), and stalls did not grace the place, and the householders did not cook, and people did not rejoice on recovering lost property or gaining a profuse accession of wealth, and mothers did not feel any delight on beholding their first-born.

sa: भर्तुः प्रियार्थं कुलरक्षणार्थं भर्तुश्च वंशस्य परिग्रहार्थम्। अहेडमानास्त्वरया स्म दूता रात्र्यां तु ते तत्पुरमेव याताः॥
en: And for pleasing their master, for the preservation of the people, and enabling Bharata to assume the reins of government, those envoys, casting aside negligence, swiftly entered the city in the night.

sa: एतद् वचस्तस्य निशम्य माता सुधर्म्यमव्यग्रमविक्लवं च। मृतेव संज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य देवी समीक्ष्य रामं पुनरित्युवाच। ५१।।
en: Hearing those pious, sober and reasonable words of Rāma, the venerable mother, regaining her sense like to the dead, and casting her look upon him, spoke to him again the following words.

sa: न च पित्रा परित्यक्तो नामर्यादः कथंचन। न लुब्धो न च दुःशीलो न च क्षत्रियपांसनः॥
en: Rāma, the enhancer of Kausalyā's delight had not been abandoned by his father, nor is he devoid of propriety of conduct; he is not avaricious, wicked nor the destroyer of Kaşatriya race.

sa: मन्त्रपूतैर्महाभागैरास्थितो हि महाक्रतुः। तद् गच्छथ विचिन्वध्वं पुत्रका भद्रमस्तु वः॥ समुद्रमालिनी सर्वां पृथिवीमनुगच्छथ। एकैकं योजनं पुत्रा विस्तारमभिगच्छत॥ यावद् तुरगसंदर्शस्तावत् खनत मेदिनीम्। तमेव हयहर्तारं मार्गमाणा ममाज्ञया॥
en: Therefore, repair you, and seek for the horse, you sons. Good betide you! Do you search the entire earth engarlanded with oceans; and do you search Yojana after Yojana, you sons. And do you delve the earth till you light upon the horse, by my command following the track of that stealer of the horse.

sa: षष्टिवर्षसहस्राणि जातस्य मम रावण। पितृपैतामहं राज्यं यथावदनुतिष्ठतः॥
en: O Rāvana, I am sixty thousand years old and have been administering regularly my ancestral kingdom.

sa: तमजय्यमधृष्यं च वानरेन्द्रममर्षणम्। विचिन्तयन्नमुं चापि ऋष्यमूकममुं त्वहम्॥
en: And thinking of that lord of monkeys, unconquerable and irrepressible I dare not leave this Rsymuka.

sa: अव्यक्तप्रभवो ब्रह्मा शाश्वतो नित्य अव्ययः॥ तस्मान्मरीचिः संजज्ञे मरीचे: कश्यपः सुतः। विवस्वान् कश्यपाज्जज्ञे मनुर्वैवस्वतः स्मृतः॥
en: The perpetual, everlasting, and undeteriorating Brahmā sprang from the Unmanifest (Brahmā). From him sprang Marīci; and Kasyapa is son to Marīci. And from Kaśyapa sprung Vivasvat; and Manu is son to Vivasvat.

sa: अभिषिक्ते तु सुग्रीवे प्रविष्टे वानरे गुहाम्। आजगाम सह भ्रात्रा रामः प्रस्रवणं गिरिम्॥ शार्दूलमृगसंघुष्टं सिंदर्भापरवैर्वृतम्। नानागुल्मलतागूढं बहुपादपसंकुलम् ॥ ऋक्षवानरगोपुच्छैाजारैश्च निषेवितम्। मेघराशिनिभं शैलं नित्यं शुचिकरं शिवम्॥
en: On Sugrīva being installed and the monkeys entering the cave, Rāma, along with his younger brother, got at the Prasravana hill, resounded with the noise of tigers and deer, filled with terrible lions, covered with diverse trees, creepers and bowers, inhabited by bears, monkeys, Gopucyas and cats, resembling a collection of clouds and always auspicious.

sa: अंहो वतेदं नृवराविषह्यं निवर्तते मे हृदि साधुवृत्तम्। अग्नौ विवर्णं परितप्यमानं किट्टं यथा राघव जातरूपम्॥
en: Alas! O best of kings, this unbearable sin has been driving away all pious feelings from my heart like to alloy leaking out of discoloured gold when molten in fire, O Rāghava.

sa: शृङ्गवेरपुरे सुतं गङ्गाकूले व्यसर्जयत्। गुहमासाद्य धर्मात्मा निषादाधिपतिं प्रियम्॥ गुहेन सहितो रामो लक्ष्मणेन च सीतया।
en: Rāma met with the virtuous and beloved king of the Nişādas; and then in company with Guha, Laksmana, and Sita, Rama dismissed his charioteer on the banks of the Ganges at Srigaverapura.

sa: स चचालाचलश्चाशु मुहूर्तं कपिपीडतः। तरूणां पुष्पिताग्राणां सर्वं पुष्पमशातयत्॥ तेन पादपमुक्तेन पुष्पौघेण सुगन्धिना। सर्वतः संवृतः शैलो बभौ पुष्पमयो यथा॥ तेन चोत्तमवीर्येण पीड्यमानः स पर्वतः। सलिलं सम्प्रसुस्राव मदमत्त इव द्विपः॥ पीड्यमानस्तु बलिना महेन्द्रस्तेन पर्वतः। रीतीनिवर्तयामास काञ्चनाञ्जनराजतीः॥
en: The hill at once shook and flowers began to drop down from the trees. Having discharged that fragrant flowers from trees covered all the sides of the mountain which appeared as though it were all flowers. Hanumān began to press the mountain more and more, and it began to spurt forth water like an elephant shedding its temporal sweat, and the golden, silvery and collyrium hues of the different minerals were all destroyed by that torrent of water.

sa: तौ दृष्ट्वा तु तदा सिद्धा समुत्थाय कृताञ्जलिः। पादौ जग्राह रामस्य लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः॥ पाद्यमाचमनीयं च सर्वं प्रादाद् यथाविधि। तामुवाच श्रमणी धर्मसंस्थिताम्॥
en: No sooner had that one of perfect asceticism beheld those highly intelligent Rāma and Laks maņa than she rose up with folded hands and touching their feet offered them duly water for washing their feet and mouth. Thereupon Rāma spoke to that female ascetic, engaged in religious services.

sa: भिद्यतेऽयं गिरिधूतैरिति मत्वा तपस्विनः। त्रस्ता विद्याधरास्तस्मादुत्पेतुः स्त्रीगणैः सह ॥ पानभूमिगतं हित्वा हैममासवभाजनम्। पात्राणि च महार्हाणि करकांश्च हिरण्मयान्॥ लेह्यानुच्चावचान् भक्ष्यान् मांसानि विविधानि च। आर्षभाणि च चर्माणि खङ्गांश्च कनकत्सरून्॥ कृतकण्ठगुणाः क्षीबा रक्तमाल्यानुलेपनाः। रक्ताक्षाः पुष्कराक्षाश्च गगनं प्रतिपेदिरे॥ हारनूपुरकेयूरपारिहार्यधराः स्त्रियः। विस्मिताः सस्मितास्तस्थुराकाशे रमणैः सह ॥
en: At this sudden convulsion, the hermits thought that they were being driven by the Rākşasas. The Vidyādharas with their woman ran away from their drinking haunts, leaving their golden seats, goblets, bowls, delicious articles for chewing, various kinds of meat, oxen, hides and swords with golden hilts. Fair damsels wearing necklaces, bracelets, anklets and carnation garlands, besmeared with red sandal paste and with their eyes red with wine dallying in amorous sports being startled by this strange occurrence, with their lovers, rose in the sky and watched the thing with delightful curiosity from above.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा जृम्भमाणं ते क्रमितुं शतयोजनम्। वेगेनापूर्यमाणं च सहसा वानरोत्तमम्॥ सहसा शोकमुत्सृज्य प्रहर्षेण समन्विताः। विनेदुस्तुष्टुवुश्चापि हनूमन्तं महाबलम्॥
en: Seeing that foremost of monkeys enlarge his person for bossing over an hundred Yojanas, and suddenly filled with energy, (the monkeys) at once renounced sorrow, and, filled with light, set up ululations and fell to eulogizing the mighty Hanuman.

sa: साध्वत्र प्रविशामेति मया तूक्ताः प्लवङ्गमाः। तेषामपि ह सर्वेषामनुमानमुपागतम्॥ अस्मिन् निपतिताः सर्वेऽप्यथ कार्यत्वरान्विताः। ततो गाढं निपतिता गृह्य हस्तैः परस्परम्॥ इदं प्रविष्टाः सहसा बिलं तिमिरसंवृतम्। . एतन्नः कार्यमेतेन कृत्येन वयमागताः॥
en: Let us enter here', said I to the monkeys. And they also arrived at that conclusion.* And thereupon they, bestirring themselves, entered into the cave. And firmly griping each other's hands, they at once made entry into the cave covered with darkness. This is our errand; and it is on this job that we have come. *Namely, that water was to be found there.

sa: मार्ग निरोद्धं सततं भास्करस्याचलोत्तमः। संदेसं पालयंस्तस्य विन्ध्यशैलो नि वर्धते ॥ अयं दीर्घायुषस्तस्य लोके विश्रुतकर्मणः। अगस्त्यस्याश्रमः श्रीमान् विनीतमृगसेवितः॥
en: This graceful asylum ranged by mild beasts belongs to that long-lived one of renowned achievements, Agastya, in obedience to whose command, the Vindhya mountain-foremost of its kind, which had always obstructed the way of the Sun, does not increase.

sa: निःस्वनं चक्रवाकानां निशम्य सहचारिणाम्। पुण्डरीकविशालाक्षी कथमेषा भविष्यति॥
en: Hearing the noise of her companionsCakravākas, how shali that one, of expansive eyes resembling lotuses, live?

sa: यस्याः कृते वने रामो न्यस्तदेहश्च वः पिता। सेयं पापा नृशंसा च तस्याः कुरु यथामति।।।।
en: That one through whom Rāma has gone to the wood and our father has renounced his body this is that wicked and remorseless one. Do you deal with her as you like.

sa: रहितां सूर्यचन्द्राभ्यां संध्यामिव महत्तमः। तामपश्यत् ततो बालां राजपुत्रीं यशस्विनीम्॥ रोहिणी शशिना हीनां ग्रहवद् भृशदारुणः।
en: He saw there the young and pious daughter of the king like to an evening void of both sun and moon and as the highly terrible Rahu eyes Rohini forsaken by Moon.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु रामेण लक्ष्मणः संयताञ्जलिः। सीतासमक्षं काकुत्स्थमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus addressed by Rāma. Lakşmaņa with joined hands, said to Kākutstha in the presence of Sītā,

sa: यथा प्रतिज्ञामिदं नरेन्द्र कृतं त्वया दृष्टफलं च कर्म। ममाद्य भोगेषु नरेन्द्रसूनो मनो निवृत्तं हतजीवितेन॥
en: O lord of men, you had fulfilled your promise by carrying it out into practice; and as for wretched me, O son of a king, I shall refrain today from all enjoyments.

sa: वर एष पुरा दत्तो मम धात्रेति सत्वरा। व्यादाय वक्त्रं विपुलं स्थिता सा मारुतेः पुरः॥
en: Even this is the boon that was conferred on me by the Deity. Having delivered herself thus, speedily, she was opening her mouth wide, stood before the son of the wind god.

sa: चर्म चास्थि च मे राम न स्पृश्यन्ति मनीषिणः। अभक्ष्याणि च मांसानि सोऽहं पञ्चनखो हतः॥
en: The wise, O Rāma, do not touch my skin and bones and my flesh is not worthy of being taken-I am that (monkey) having five toes who have been killed by you.

sa: एतत् सुरुचिरं भाति पितुर्मे शयनं पुरा। शशिनेवामलं रात्रौ गगनं तोयदात्यये॥ तदिदं न विभात्यद्य विहीनं तेन धीमता। व्योमेव शशिना हीनमप्शुष्क इव सागरः॥
en: This bed of my father used to look like the speckless welkin at night crowned with the moon, after the clouds have gone off. But to-day, deprived of that intellignet one, it ceases to shine, like the firmament without the moon or the sea devoid of its waters.

sa: शोकं विसृज्याद्य धृतिं भजस्व सोत्साहता चास्तु विमार्गणेऽस्याः। उत्साहवन्तो हि नरा न लोके सीदन्ति कर्मस्वतिदुष्करेषु॥.
en: Do you take heart renouncing your grief and engage with energy of Sita. Persons of high energy are never exhausted on the earth in quest even in the face of arduous works.

sa: अतो भूयोऽपि नेदानीमिक्ष्वाकुपुरवासिनः। स्वपेयुरनुरक्ता मा वृक्षमूलेषु संश्रिताः॥
en: Attached to me, the denizons of Ikşvāku's city will not again indulge in sleep underneath trees.

sa: अहमप्यवनों प्राप्ते रामे सत्यपराक्रमे। कृतकृत्यो भविष्यामि विप्रवासितकल्मषः॥
en: On Rāma having truth for prowess, obtaining the earth, I, my disgrace removed, shall be blest.

sa: कृताञ्जलौ स्थिते तस्मिन् वानराश्चाभवंस्तथा। तटाकमिव तं दृष्ट्वा रामः कुड्मलपङ्कजम्॥ वानराणां महत् सैन्यं सुग्रीवे प्रीतिमानभूत्।
en: And when Sugrīva has folded his hands, the monkeys also did so. And beholding the mighty host of the monkeys resembling a tank filled with lotus buds, Rāma was well-pleased with Sugriva.

sa: रक्तोत्पलवनैश्चात्र मण्डिताश्च हिरण्मयैः॥ तरुणादित्यसंकाशा भान्ति तत्र जलाशयाः।
en: And the pools here, resembling the tender sun, are embellished with assemblages of golden red lotuses.

sa: एतद् वचननैष्ठुर्यमूचुः संरक्तलोचनाः॥ वासिष्ठा मुनिशार्दूल सर्वे सहमहोदयाः।
en: These cruel words, O powerful ascetic, did Vasiştha's sons together with Mahodaya, utter with reddened eyes.'

sa: ततो हैमवती ज्येष्ठा सर्वलोकनमस्कृता। तदा सातिमहदूपं कृत्वा वेगं च दुःसहम्॥ आकाशादपतद् राम शिवे शिवशिरस्युत।
en: Then, O Rāma. that one bowed to by all creatures, the elder daughter of Himavat, assuming an exceedingly mighty shape, with irresistible impetus precipitated herself from the welkin upon Siva's gracious head.

sa: तेषां तद् श्रुत्वा सर्वेषां मुनिपुङ्गवः॥ क्रोधसंरक्तनयनः सरोषमिदमब्रवीत्।
en: Hearing those words of theirs, that foremost of ascetics, with eyes reddened in anger, wrathfully cried.

sa: ततः पश्चान्महोतेजा नाराचान् भास्करोपमान्। जघान राक्षसं क्रुद्धस्त्रयोदश शिलाशितान्॥ रथस्य युगमेकेन चतुर्भिः शबलान् हयान्। षष्ठेन च शिरः संख्ये चिच्छेद खरसारथेः ॥ त्रिभिस्त्रिवेणून् बलवान् द्वाभ्यामक्षं महाबलः। द्वादशेन तु बाणेन खरस्य सकरं धनुः॥ छित्त्वा वज्रनिकाशेन राघवः प्रहसन्निव। त्रयोदशेनेन्द्रसमो बिभेद समरे खरम्॥
en: Then that highly energetic one, influenced by anger, assailed the Räkşasa with thirteen närācas whetted on stone and with one that exceedingly powerful one, cut the yoke of the car, with four the four steeds, with the sixth the head of Khara's charioteer, with three the stout trivenu of the car, with two the wheel, and with the twelfth, severing as if in sport Khara's bow with his hand*, with the thirteenth, resembling the thunder-bolt pierced Khara in the encounter. Another text reads: with the arrow set.

sa: इन्द्रजानुः कविर्वीरो यूथपः प्रत्यदृश्यत॥ एकादशानां कोटीनामीश्वरस्तैश्च संवृतः।
en: And then appeared Indrajāni, the heroic monkey and leader of herds-lord of eleven kotis-surrounded by them.

sa: मया त्वेतद् वचः श्रुत्वा याचितः स परंतपः। शापयित्वा च मां पद्भ्यां प्रविवेश बिलं ततः॥
en: Hearing his speech, that subduer of foes was besought by me (for permission to enter the cave along with him). But making me swear by touching his feet he entered the cave.

sa: अथ शैलसुता राम त्रिदशानिदमब्रवीत्॥ समन्युरशपत् सर्वान् क्रोधसंरक्तलोचना।
en: Then the Mountain's daughter, O Rama, addressed the celestials, cursing them with eyes reddened in wrath.

sa: राजमार्गेण महता सुविभक्तेन शोभिता। मुक्तपुष्पावकीर्णेन जलसिक्तेन नित्यशः॥
en: And scattered with blown blossoms, and regularly sprinkled with water; the well-arranged broad high-ways looked beautiful.

sa: स पुनस्त्वपरान् सप्त शरानादाय मर्मणि। निजघान रणे कुद्धः शक्राशनिसमप्रभान्॥ ततः शरसहस्रेण राममप्रतिमौजसम्। अर्दयित्वा महानादं ननाद समरे खरः॥
en: Then taking up seven other shafts, resplendent like the thunderbolt of Sakra, Khara, enraged, sent them into (Rāma's) main-joints, and then afflicting Rāma of unparalleled energy with a thousand shafts, Khara sent up in that conflict a loud shout.

sa: गुहमेवं ब्रुवाणं तु राघवः प्रत्युवाच ह। अर्चिताश्चैव हृष्टाश्च भवता सर्वदा वयम्॥ पद्भ्यामभिगमाच्चैव स्नेहसंदर्शनेन च।
en: When Guha had said this, Rāghava answered him, saying, “We have been well received by you and are well pleased with you, since coming here on foot you have shown us affection."

sa: नाराजके जनपदे शरान् संततमस्यताम्। श्रूयते तलनिर्घोष इष्वस्त्राणामुपासने॥
en: In a kingless country one hears not the clappings of persons engaged in shooting arrows constantly.

sa: शाल्मली: किंशुकाशोकाञ्छिशपाः सरलांस्तथा। चकोरैः शतपत्रैश्च भृङ्गराजैस्तथा शुकैः॥
en: Salmalis, Kinshukas, Ashokas, Singshapas and Saralas. And these trees were inhabited by Chakoras, Satapatras, Bhringarajas, Shukas,

sa: तासां नाम च रूपं च भोजनाच्छादनानि च। सर्वासामेव वेदाहं कर्म चैव कर्म चैव कृताकृतम्॥
en: I knew the names and features of every one of those girls and also what they used to eat and what they used to wear and what they used not to do.

sa: अहिंसेति यदुक्तं हि पुरुषैर्विस्मितैः पुरा। के न हिंसन्ति जीवान् वैलोकेऽस्मिन् द्विजसत्तम बहु संचित्य इति वै नास्ति कश्चिदहिंसकः॥
en: O foremost of men, who is there on earth who does not do harm to any creature? After full consideration, this is the conclusion (that I have come to that there is none who has not killed an animal.

sa: सहदेवस्तु धर्मात्मा सैन्यं दृष्ट्वा भयादितम्। परीतमग्निना राजन् नाकम्पत यथाचलः। उपस्पृश्य शुचिर्भूत्वा सोऽब्रवीत् पावकं ततः॥
en: O king, the virtuous-minded Sahadeva also, seeing his troops afflicted with fear and encircled with flames, stood motionless as a mountain. Touching water and purifying himself, he thus spoke to Pavaka (fire).

sa: अथ ब्राह्मणो वृषदर्भसकाशं गत्वा अश्वसहस्रमयाचत्। स राजा तं कशेनाताडयत्॥ तं ब्राह्मणोऽब्रवीत्। किं हिस्यनागसं मामिति॥
en: Thereupon the Brahmana went TO Vrishadarbha and begged one thousand horses. That king (however) struck him with a whip. Then the Brahmana said, "I am innocent, why do you strike me thus?”

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच वनेषु तेष्वेव तु ते नरेन्द्राः सहार्जुनेनेन्द्रसमेन वीराः। तस्मिंश्च शैलप्रवरे सुरम्ये धनेश्वराक्रीडगता विजह्वः
en: Vaishampayana said : Those foremost of men, brave as Indra, together with Arjuna, sported in the pleasuregardens of the lord of wealth (situated) in those forests on that excellent and beautiful mountain.

sa: स ह्यासनवरं श्रीमत् पुष्पकं विश्वकर्मणा। विहितं चित्रपर्यन्तमातिष्ठतधनाधिपः॥
en: That illustrious one (Kubera) was seated on that excellent seat the Pushpaka painted with various colours.

sa: भूयोऽपि दुःखं मम भीमसेन दूये विषस्येव रसं हि पीत्वा। यद् याज्ञसेनी परिक्लिश्यमानां संदृश्य तत् क्षान्तमिति स्म भीम॥
en: O Bhimasena, this was my great grief that I could not do anything when I saw Yajnaseni (Draupadi) persecuted in that way. O Bhima, my heart burns on account of this, as if I have drunk some poisonous liquid.

sa: तत्र विद्याव्रतस्तातः कौमारं व्रतमास्थितः। शमथोऽकथयद् राजन्नामूर्तरयसं गयम्॥
en: O king, the learned and vow-observing and celebrated Samatha spoke of Gaya, the son of Amurtaya.

sa: किं कारणमित्यपृच्छदधाचष्ट नारदः। अहं परिभ्रमन् वसुमनसो गृहमुपस्थितः॥
en: He asked "For what cause?” Narada said, “Wandering about I came to the house of Vasumana.

sa: शीघ्रमेव भवस्वाग्निस्त्वं पुनर्लोकभावनः। विज्ञातश्चासि लोकेषु त्रिषु संस्थानचारिषु॥
en: "Soon become Agni, the protector of the world, you are celebrated over the three stable worlds.

sa: सहदेववचः श्रुत्वा नकुलोऽपि विशाम्पते। दर्शनीयतमो नृणामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said O king, hearing the words of Sahadeva, Nakula, the handsomest of men, spoke thus.

sa: ततश्च बाहुदां गच्छेद् ब्रह्मचारी समाहितः। तत्रोष्य राजनीमेकां स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥ देवसत्रस्य यज्ञस्य फलं प्राप्नोति कौरवा
en: Then one should with Brahmacharya life go to Bahuda. Living there for one night, one becomes adored in celestials region. O descendant of Kuru, he obtains the fruits of the Devasatra sacrifice.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच भूय एव महाभाग्यं कथ्यतामित्यब्रवीत् पाण्डवः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : The Pandavas again said, “Tell us again of the greatness (of the Kshatriyas).

sa: ऋष्यशृङ्गं मुनिसुतमानयस्व च पार्थिव। वानेयमनभिज्ञं च नारीणामार्जवे रतम्॥ स चेदवतरेद् राजन् विषयं ते महातपाः। सद्यः प्रवर्षेत् पर्जन्य इति मे नात्र संशयः॥
en: O king, send for the Rishi's Rishyashringa who knows nothing of the female sex, who dwells in the forest and who takes delight in simplicity. If that great ascetic, O king, come to your kingdom, there is not the least doubt that the clouds will instantly pour rains."

sa: पिता पितामहश्चैव सर्वे च प्रपितामहाः। पितामहपुरोगाश्च देवाः सर्षिगणा नृप॥ तवधर्मेणधर्मज्ञ नित्यमेवाभितोषिताः। अवाप्स्यसि त्वं लोकान् वै वसूनां वासवोपम्। कीर्तिं च महतीं भीष्म प्राप्स्यसे भुवि शाश्वतीम्।१११।।
en: O king, you have always gratified by your virtue your father, your grandfather, your great grandfather and also the celestials with Grandsire (Brahma) at their head and also the Rishis, O virtuous man, O Vasava-like hero, O Bhishma, you will attain to the region of the Vasus and you will acquire eternal fame on earth.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच कथं वै ज्ञातयो ब्रह्मन् कारणं चात्र किं मुने। कथं समुद्रः पूर्णश्च भगीरथप्रतिश्रयात्॥
en: Yudhishthira said : O Brahmana, O Rishi, why and how did the relations (of Bhagiratha) become the cause (of refilling the ocean)? How was the ocean refilled by the interference of Bhagiratha?

sa: इङ्गुदान् करमर्दाश्च तिन्दुकांश्च महाफलान्। एतानन्यांश्च विविधान् गन्धमादनसानुषु॥
en: Inguda, Karamarda, Tinduka and Mahaphalas, these any many other trees on the plateau of the Gandhamadana,

sa: अधारयच्छत्रमस्य सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। धनंजयश्च व्यजने भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः॥
en: The greatly powerful Satyaki held the umbrella and Dhananjaya (Arjuna) and Bhima fanned the Pandava (Yudhishthira).

sa: तदद्भुताकारमहं दृष्ट्वा नगरमुत्तमम्। विशिष्टं देवनगरादपृच्छं मातलिं ततः॥
en: Then beholding that wonderful and excellent city, superior to that of the gods, I asked Matali,

sa: ततस्ते दानवास्तत्र वादित्राणि सहस्रशः। विकृतस्वररूपाणि भृशं सर्वाण्यनादयन्॥
en: Thereupon the Danavas vehemently began to sound thousands of musical instruments, discordant and of awkward shapes.

sa: तेनैव प्राप्नुयात् प्राज्ञो हयमेधफलं नरः। ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया वैश्याः शूद्रा वा राजसत्तम॥ न वै योनौ प्रजायन्ते सघतास्तीर्थे महात्मनः।
en: O foremost of kings, the wise men obtain by it the fruits of the Ashvamedha sacrifice. Among the Brahmanas, Kshatriyas, Vaisyas and Sudras, those that are high-souled are freed from the bondage of rebirth, if they bathe in it.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् कलिः शक्रं दमयन्त्याः स्वयंवरम्। गत्वा हि वरयिष्ये तां मनो हि मम तां गतम्॥
en: Thereupon Kali replying to Shakra's words said, 'Hearing the Svayamvara of Damayanti, I am going there. I shall take her to be my wife; for my heart has been captivated by her?'

sa: ततो विषण्णमनसो मम राजन् सुहृज्जनाः। रुरुदुशुक्रुशुश्चैव दुःखशोकसमन्विताः॥
en: O king, my friends, afflicted with sorrow and grief, then wept and wailed in sorrowful hearts.

sa: शकुनिरुवाच अमुञ्चत् स्थविरो यद् वो धनं पूजितमेव तत्। महाधनं ग्लहं त्वेकं शृणु भो भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Shakuni said O best of the Bharata race the old king has given you back all your wealth. That is well. But listen to me, there is a stake of great value.

sa: रामपत्नीकृते येन शतयोजनविस्तृतः। सागर: प्लवगेन्द्रेण क्रमेणैकेन लवित्तः॥
en: The ocean extending over one hundred yojanas was leaped over by that monkey for Rama's wife.

sa: सोऽस्माभिः पृष्टो भवानिममिन्द्रद्युम्नं राजानमभिजानातीति एवं मुहूर्त ध्यात्वाब्रवीनाभिजानाम्यहमिन्द्रद्युम्नं राजानमिति। ततः सोऽस्माभिः पृष्टः कश्चिद् भवतोऽन्यश्चिरजाततरोऽस्तीति। स नोऽब्रवीदस्ति खल्वस्मिन्नेव सरस्यकूपारो नाम कच्छपः प्रतिवसति। स मत्तश्चिरजाततरः। स यदि कथंचिदभिजानीयादिम राजानं तमकूपारं पृच्छध्वमिति॥
en: We asked the crane, “Do you know this king Indradhyumna.” He reflected for a moment and then said, "I do not know the king Indradyumna." Thereupon we asked him, “Is there any one more long-lived than you?" He said, “Yes. Here lives in this lake a tortoise named Akupara. He is older than I. He might know something of this king. Therefore ask Akupara."

sa: एत्य नो नार्जुनो गर्हेद् यथा तात तथा कुरु। चक्रव्यूहस्य न वयं विद्मो भेदं कथंचन॥
en: "O son, do you so act, that coming back, Arjuna may not have reason to reproach us. The means for breaking the circular array, is not known to any one of us.

sa: तथान्यैर्निशितैर्बाणैः सुषेण दीर्घलोचनम्। कुण्डभेदिं च संकुद्धस्त्रिभिस्त्रीनवधीद् बली॥
en: Then with other sharp arrows the valiant Abhimanyu inflamed with rage, slew Sushena, Dirghalochana and Kundabhedhin.

sa: प्रहरन्तमनीकानि पिता देवव्रतस्तव॥ दृष्ट्वा सेनापति भीष्मस्त्वरितः श्वेतमभ्ययात्।
en: Seeing that (Pandava) general striking Duryodhana's troops,, your father Bhishma, also called Devavrata, rushed upon him.

sa: ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते। सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्॥
en: Those, however, who worship the Imperishable, the All pervading, Inconceivable, the Indifferent, the Immutable, the Eternal.

sa: भवानग्रे रथोदारः सह सर्वैः सहोदरैः। दुःशासनप्रभृतिभिर्धातृभिः शतसम्मितैः॥
en: You, along with all your brothers Dushasana and others, are the foremost among car-warriors. on are

sa: भगदत्तस्तु राजानं दुपदं नतपर्वभिः। सनियन्तृध्वजरथं विव्याध पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Bhagadatta, the foremost of men, pierced with close-jointed shafts, king Drupada, his charioteer, flag-staffs and chariot.

sa: दुर्मर्षणश्च विंशत्या चित्रसेनश्च पञ्चभिः। दुर्मुखो नवभिर्बाणैर्दुःसहश्चापि सप्तभिः॥
en: Durmarshana pierced him (Dhrishtadyumna) with twenty shafts, Chitrasena with five, Durmukha with nine, Dusaha with seven.

sa: सर्वाणि सैन्यानि त तावकानि यतो यतो गाण्डिवजः प्रणादः। ततस्ततः संनतिमेव जग्मुन तं प्रतीपोऽभिससार कश्चित्॥
en: Having known that twang t have been produced by the Gandiva, king Virata, and the foremost of men, and the brave Panchala king Drupada all went to the place with unrepressed hearts.

sa: कर्ण उवाच वचनं कृष्णः न विप्रियं करिष्यामि धार्तराष्ट्रस्य केशव। त्यक्तप्राणं हि मां विद्धि दुर्योधनहितैषिणम्॥
en: Karna said O Keshava, I shall not do anything that is disagreeable to Dhritarashtra's son (Duryodhana), I am ever devoted to him, know, that my life has been cast off for him.

sa: स्पर्शा गन्धा रसाश्चैव विपरीता महीपते॥ धूम ध्वजाः प्रमुञ्चन्ति कम्पमाना मुहुर्मुहुः। मुञ्चन्त्यङ्गारवर्षं च भेर्यश्च पटहास्तथा॥
en: O kings, touch, smell and taste have become quite the contrary. The standards of the warriors often tremble and they send forth smoke. Drums and cymbals cast off showers of coat dust.

sa: स ययौ रथवंशेन यत्र राजा युधिष्ठिरः। तदापतद् वै सहसा शल्यस्य समुदहद् बलम्॥ महौघवेगं समरे वारयामास पाण्डवः। मद्रराजं च समरे धर्मराजो महारथः॥ दशभिः सायकैस्तूर्णमाजघान स्तनान्तरे। नकुलः सहदेवश्च तं सप्तभिरजिह्मगैः॥
en: Supported by a division of cars, tied to the spot where king Yudhishthira was. Then the son of Pandu checked in battle that detachment of Shalya falling upon him with great fury. Then that mighty car-warrior the very virtuous king Yudhishthira quickly pierced the king of the Madras with ten shafts between his breasts; and Nakula and Sahadeva pierced him with seven straight wafts.

sa: ध्रुवं च त्वां हनिष्यामि शपे सत्येन तेऽग्रतः। एतच्छुत्रा च मद्वाक्यं यत् कृत्यं तत् समाचर॥
en: O foremost of men, I will fight with you this day on the field of battle, and will, without doubt, slay you in battle. This I swear by my troth before you.

sa: स शेते निहतो भूमौ वातभग्न इव द्रुमः। तव दुर्मत्रिते राजन् यथा नाहः स भारत॥
en: O king, that descendant of Bharata even he, now killed by the enemy, lies, though he does not deserve it, on the bare ground like a large tree broken by the wind.

sa: वासुदेवस्त्वसम्भ्रान्तो धैर्यमास्थाय सत्त्ववान्। चोदयामास तानश्वान् विचितान् भीष्मसायकैः॥
en: The greatly powerful Vasudeva however, fearlessly and patiently drove the horses now wounded by Bhishma's arrow.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच षड्थान् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य मन्यसे यान् बलाधिकान्। तेषां वीर्ये ममार्धेन न तुल्यमिति मे मतिः॥
en: Arjuna said Those six car-warriors of the Dhartarastra host whom you consider to be superior to me in strength, I think their prowess is not even equal to half that of mine.

sa: अमृष्यमाणास्ते सर्वे सुबलस्यात्मजा रणे। इरावन्तमभिदुत्य सर्वतः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: The sons of Subala not tolerating it is battle, rushing at Iravat, surrounded him on sides.

sa: ततः स राजा दुपदस्य श्रुत्वा विमर्षयुक्तो युवतीर्वरिष्ठाः। सम्प्रेषयामास सुचारुरूपाः शिखण्डिनं स्त्री पुमान् वेति वेत्तुम्॥
en: Thereupon that king, hearing (the words) of the Drupada, became dejected, and sent some choice, youthful ladies of great beauty to Shikhandin to ascertain whether he was a man or a woman.

sa: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं कर्मारपरिमार्जितम्। नाराचं विससर्जास्मै तं द्रौणिस्त्रिभिराच्छिनत्॥
en: Having spoken only these words, he hurled at him a Naracha burnished by the forger himself.

sa: यत् तु कार्यं भवेत् कार्ये कर्मणा तत् समाचर। हीनचेष्टस्य यः शोकः स हि शत्रुर्धनंजय॥
en: What should be done should be done (without hesitation). Do your duty with all endeavours, O Dhananjaya, the grief that deprives one of the power of acting, is indeed his greatest enemy.

sa: ऋक्षवानररक्षांसि जनाश्च पुरवासिनः। आगच्छन्परया भक्त्या पृष्ठतः सुसमाहिताः॥
en: Bears, monkeys and Räkşasas and all the citizens, followed him with great devotion and collected minds.

sa: चकार पत्नी कन्यां तु तथा तां गिरिकां नृपः। वसोः पत्नी तु गिरिका कामकालं न्यवेदयत्॥ ऋतुकालमनुप्राप्ता स्नाता पुंसवने शुचिः। तदहः पितरश्चैनमूचुर्जहि मृगानिति॥
en: The king made the daughter of the river who was called Girika his wife; and Girika, the wife of Vasu, purifying herself by a bath when her season of impurity came, told her state to her husband. But that very day the ancestors of Vasu came to him;

sa: स गत्वा विविधाञ्छैलान् देशान् बहुविधांस्तथा। अदृश्यन्त्याख्यया वध्वाथाश्रमेऽनुसृतोऽभवत्॥
en: When he was thus returning, crossing various mountains and countries, his daughterin-law Adrishyanti was following him.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमस्त्विति तां राजा प्रत्युवाचाविचारयन्। अपि च त्वां हि नेष्यामि नगरं स्वं शुचिस्मिते॥
en: Vaishampayana said: The king, without taking time to consider the demand, told her at once, “O beauty of sweet smiles, let it be so. I shall even take you to my capital.

sa: यदाश्रौषं सैन्धवार्थे प्रतिज्ञा प्रतिज्ञातां तद्वधायार्जुनेन। सत्यां तीर्णां शत्रुमध्ये च तेन तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Arjuna had taken the vow of killing Saindhava and he had fulfilled his vow in the presence of his enemies.

sa: एवमुक्तस्ततः कृष्णः प्रत्युवाच वृकोदरम्। त्वरयन् पुरुषव्याघ्रो जरासंधवधेप्सया॥ यत् ते दैवं परं सत्त्वं यच्च ते मातरिश्वनः। बलं भीम जरासंधे दर्शयाशु तदद्य नः॥
en: Having been thus addressed, Krishna, that best of men, with the desire of seeing soon an end of Jarasandha, thus replied to Vrikodara (Bhima), “O Bhima, the strength that you have derived from the celestials, the might that you have obtained from Maruta, display them today towards Jarasandha."

sa: देवयान्युवाच यस्याङ्गिरा वृद्धतमः पितामहो बृहस्पतिश्चापि पिता तपोनिधिः। ऋषेः पुत्रं तमथो वापि पौत्रं कथं न शोचेयमहं न रुद्याम्॥
en: Devayani said : Why should I not grieve and weep for Kacha, whose grandfather is old Angirasa himself and whose father is the great ascetic Brihaspati, who is the grandson of a Rishi and the son of a Rishi.

sa: ययातिरुवाच अददद् देवयानाय यावद् वित्तमविन्दता उशीनरस्य पुत्रोऽयं तस्माच्छ्रेष्ठो हि वः शिबिः॥ दानं तपः सत्यमथापि धर्मो ही: श्रीः क्षमा सौम्यमथो विधित्सा। राजन्नेतान्यप्रमेयाणि राज्ञः शिबेः स्थितान्यप्रतिमस्य बुद्ध्या॥ एवंवृत्तो ह्रीनिषेवश्च यस्मात् तस्माच्छिबिरत्यगाद् वै रथेन।
en: Yayati said : This son of Ushinara had given all he possessed to attain to the region of Brahma. Therefore, he is the foremost among all of you. Shibi's liberality, asceticism, truth, virtue, modesty, good fortune, forgiveness, amiability and desire of performing good acts, have been so great that none can measure them. The king Sibi is crowned with righteousness and is bashful, therefore he is foremost among all of us.

sa: पर्वोक्तं भगवद्गीता पर्व भीष्मवधस्ततः। द्रोणाभिषेचनं पर्व संशप्तकवधस्ततः॥
en: Then Bhagavad-Gita Parva, then Bhishmavadha, then the installation of Drona and then the death of Sanshaptakas;

sa: याज उवाच याजेन श्रपितं हव्यमुपयाजाभिमन्त्रितम्। कथं कामं न संदध्यात् सा त्वं विप्रेहि तिष्ठ वा॥
en: Yaja said : Whether you come or wait, why should not the object of this sacrifice be accomplished when the oblation has already been prepared by me and sanctified by Upayaja's invocations!

sa: ध्रुवमेष्यति भीमोऽयं निहत्य पुरुषादकम्। सर्वथा ब्राह्मणस्यार्थे यदनुक्रोशवत्यसि॥
en: Because you are compassionate for the Brahmana, Bhima will certainly come back after killing the cannibal.

sa: देवयान्युवाच किमिदं वृजिनं सुभ्र कृतं वै कामलुब्धया।॥
en: Devayani said: O girl of fair-eye-brows, what sin is this you have committed out of lust!

sa: त्रासयन्तोऽभिनिनन्तः सर्वभूतगणांश्च ते। विचेसः सर्वशो राजन्महीं शतसहस्रशः॥
en: O king, frightening and killing all creatures, they roamed over the earth in hundred and thousands.

sa: नीतिमान् सकलां नीति विबुधाधिपतेस्तदा। अवाप्य सहदेवोऽपि भ्रातृणां ववृते वशे॥ द्रोणेनैव विनीतश्च भ्रातृणां नकुलः प्रियः। चित्रयोधी समाख्यातो बभूवातिरथोदितः॥
en: Sahadeva, obtaining the whole science of morality and duties from the lord of all science Drona, remained obedient to his brothers. Nakula, the favourite of his brothers, taught by Drona, became known ass a skilful warrior and a car-warrior.

sa: अर्जुनः खलु द्वारवतीं गत्वा भगिनीं वासुदेवस्य सुभद्रां भद्रभाषिणी भार्यामुदावहत्। स्वविषयं चाभ्याजगाम कुशली। तस्यां पुत्रमभिमन्युमतीव गुणसम्पन्नं दयितं वासुदेवस्याजनयत्॥
en: Arjuna went to Dwarika and there he married by force the sweet-speeched Subhadra, the sister of Vasudeva (Krishna). He begot on her a son, named Abhimanyu, who was endued with all accomplishments and who was dear to Vasudeva himself.

sa: मरीचिरङ्गिराश्चैव पुलस्त्य: पुलहः क्रतुः। दक्षः प्रजापतिश्चैव गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा॥
en: Marichi, Angira, Pulastya, Pulaha Kratu, the Prajapati Daksha, the Gandharvas and he Apsaras, all came there.

sa: सुतस्यैतदिह प्रोक्तं व्यासेन परमर्षिणा। एतदेकादशं पर्व शोकवैक्लव्यकारणम्॥
en: All this has been described by the great Rishi Vyasa in the most pathetic eleventh Parva.

sa: अब्रवीद्भगिनी तत्र वासुकेः संनिवेशने। नावमानात्कृतवती तवाहं विप्रबोधनम्॥
en: She spoke to him, “O Brahmana, I have not waken you from any desire of insult.

sa: भगिनी तव दुर्वृत्त रक्षसां वै यशोहर। त्वन्नियोगेन चैवेयं रूपं मम समीक्ष्य च॥ कामय.यद्य मां भीरुस्तव नैषापराध्यति। अनङ्गेन कृते दोघे नेमां गर्हितुमर्हसि॥
en: o wicked creature, O you the most infamous of your class, your sister came here at your command. Seeing my person, she desire me. The timid girl has done you no harm. It is the fault of the god of love and therefore, you should not injure her.

sa: तद्वाक्यं राघवेणोक्तं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः। द्विजान्सर्वान्समाहूय दर्शयामास राघवम्॥
en: Hearing the words of Rama, Laksmana, of unmitigated prowess, invited all those Brāhmaṇas and approached Rāma.

sa: अथ तेषूपविष्टेषु सर्वेष्वेव तपस्विषु। निर्दिष्टमासनं भेजे विनयाल्लौमहर्षणिः॥
en: After the Rishis had taken their seats, Lomaharshana's son humbly took the seat assigned to him.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु देवान्संप्राप्तानगस्त्यस्तपसां निधिः। अर्चयामास धर्मात्मा सर्वांस्तानविशेषतः॥
en: There upon beholding the celestials present the virtuous-souled Agastya, the jewel of asceticism, welcomed them particularly.

sa: तस्याहं स्वर्गिणो वाक्यं श्रुत्वा दुःखसमन्वितम्। तारणायोफ्जग्राह तदाभरणमुत्तमम्॥
en: Hearing those words of the heavenly being, exciting pity, I accepted this ornament for saving him.

sa: तथैवोरगसङ्घाताः पाण्डवस्य समीपतः। उत्सृजन्तो विषं घोरं निपेतुर्खलिताननाः॥
en: Many Nagas also came down upon the Pandava (Arjuna), all with faces emitting most virulent poisons.

sa: यज्ञसेनस्य दुहिता द्रुपदस्य महात्मनः। वेदीमध्यात् समुत्पन्ना पद्मपत्रनिभेक्षणा॥
en: The daughter of the illustrious Yajnasena Drupada was born from the sacrificial altar, like lotus leaves,

sa: यदाश्रौषं शान्तनवे शयाने पानीयार्थे चोदितेनार्जुनेन। भूमि भित्त्वा तर्पितं तत्र भीष्मं तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
